*Arthur Hoarau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“认知校准”这一新准则，用于评估二阶分类模型中认知不确定性估计的可信度，并证明其比传统校准更强。作者提出EECE估计量，实验表明不同不确定性量化方法在认知校准上存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统校准仅评估预测概率的可靠性，无法判断认知不确定性估计本身是否可信，这在高风险场景中尤为关键。

Method: 定义认知校准准则，证明其严格强于经典校准；提出Expected Epistemic Calibration Error (EECE)作为一致估计量；通过广泛实验验证。

Result: EECE是一致估计量；不同不确定性量化方法在认知校准上存在显著差异，尽管预测性能相似。

Conclusion: 认知校准是评估二阶分类模型不确定性估计的有意义且一致的标准，能揭示标准指标无法捕捉的失败模式。

Abstract: Uncertainty estimation is critical for deploying machine learning models in high-stakes settings. However, classical calibration only assesses the reliability of predicted probabilities and does not evaluate whether epistemic uncertainty estimates are themselves trustworthy. This limitation is particularly relevant for second-order classification models. We introduce epistemic calibration, a principled criterion that measures whether reported epistemic uncertainty faithfully reflects the dispersion of model predictions around the ground truth. We show that epistemic calibration is a strictly stronger notion than classical calibration and captures failure modes invisible to standard metrics. We relate this work to the existing literature through an impossibility theorem that holds under the epistemic calibration hypothesis. To operationalize this concept, we propose the Expected Epistemic Calibration Error (EECE), which we prove to be a consistent estimator of a True Epistemic Calibration Error (TECE). Experiments across a broad range of uncertainty quantification methods show that epistemic calibration is a coherent and meaningful criterion and reveal substantial differences across methods, despite similar predictive performance.

</details>


### [359] [Closing the Modality Gap in Zero-Shot HAR: Contrastive Training and Separability-Optimized Prototypes on IMU Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10789)
*Anik Ghosh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对IMU人体活动识别的零样本学习，研究了传感器嵌入与语义表示之间的模态差距问题。通过在PAMAP2数据集上的系统实验发现，模态差距是训练阶段由编码器目标函数导致的现象。使用TCN结合区分性活动描述文本（而非标签名）作为原型目标，可将传感器嵌入与文本原型的余弦相似度从0.30提升至0.69。结合对比训练与逆softmax校正的方法在未见类上达到73.2%准确率和0.583宏F1，远超基线。同时发现丰富文本描述会降低原型间可分离性，但只要保留足够区分性词汇，对比对齐仍有效。建议采用宏平均F1作为ZSL-HAR的标准评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决零样本学习（ZSL）在基于IMU的人体活动识别（HAR）中的核心挑战：弥合传感器嵌入与语义类表示之间的模态差距。

Method: 在PAMAP2数据集上系统评估了三种推理方法与两种训练流程组合的七种配置（14个可见类、4个未见类，受试者108和109留出测试）。使用TCN编码器，对比了标签名Sentence-BERT原型与区分性活动描述文本作为训练目标，结合对比训练与逆softmax校正等方法。

Result: 使用区分性描述文本将传感器嵌入与文本原型的余弦相似度从0.30提升至0.69。最强配置（对比训练+逆softmax校正）在未见类上达73.2%准确率和0.583宏F1，基线仅为58.3%准确率和0.34宏F1。发现丰富文本描述会降低原型间可分离性，但对比对齐优势仍保持。

Conclusion: 模态差距是训练阶段现象而非推理阶段问题；文本语义质量对对齐效果至关重要；建议使用宏平均F1而非总体准确率作为ZSL-HAR不平衡数据集的报告指标。

Abstract: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) for inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based human activity recognition (HAR) faces a central challenge: bridging the gap between sensor embeddings and semantic class representations. We systematically evaluate seven configurations combining three inference methods with two training pipelines on the PAMAP2 dataset, using 14 seen and 4 unseen activity classes with subjects 108 and 109 held out for testing. We find that the modality gap is a training-time phenomenon governed by the encoder objective. A temporal convolutional network (TCN) trained with cross-entropy over label-name Sentence- BERT prototypes yields sensor embeddings with a mean cosine similarity of 0.30 to the corresponding text prototypes, while replacing the label-name prototype targets with discriminative activity descriptions raises this to 0.69. This alignment improvement transfers consistently across all three inference methods. The strongest result combines contrastive training with inverted softmax correction, achieving 73.2% accuracy and 0.583 macro F1 on unseen classes, compared to 58.3% accuracy and 0.34 macro F1 for the label-name baseline. A secondary finding is that richer text descriptions reduce inter-prototype separability in Sentence-BERT space, because shared biomechanical vocabulary causes the language model to compress the prototype cloud. This effect does not negate the benefits of contrastive alignment provided prototype descriptions retain sufficient discriminative vocabulary. We also demonstrate that overall accuracy is a misleading primary metric when test-set class distributions are imbalanced, and recommend macro-averaged F1 as the standard reporting metric for ZSL-HAR benchmarks.

</details>


### [360] [CITRAS-FM: Tiny Time Series Foundation Model for Covariate-Informed Zero-Shot Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10798)
*Yosuke Yamaguchi,Issei Suemitsu,Yuki Kajihara,Wenpeng Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CITRAS-FM 是一个仅 7M 参数的小型时间序列基础模型，通过 Shifted Attention 和 CovSynth 合成协变量技术，支持单变量、多变量及协变量信息引导的零样本预测，在 fev-bench 上以亚 0.1 秒 CPU 推理达到 SOTA 精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型计算成本高，且对多样化变量类型支持有限，未能充分利用在预测期内已知的外生协变量信息。

Method: 提出 CITRAS-FM（7M 参数，基于 patch 的 decoder-only Transformer），引入 Shifted Attention 到跨变量模块以利用预测期内的协变量；提出 CovSynth 从目标序列的分解分量中合成真实协变量，解决协变量丰富语料稀缺问题。

Result: 在 fev-bench（100 个任务）上，CITRAS-FM 在 10M 以下参数 TSFM 中零样本预测精度达到 SOTA，CPU 推理时间低于 0.1 秒。

Conclusion: CITRAS-FM 在预测精度与实时部署可行性之间取得了强平衡，为轻量级协变量感知的时间序列零样本预测提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Pretrained time series foundation models (TSFMs) have enabled zero-shot forecasting on unseen target series. However, existing TSFMs often incur high computational cost and provide limited support for diverse variable types, often failing to account for covariates that exogenously influence target variability. To address these challenges, we propose CITRAS-FM, a tiny 7M-parameter TSFM that supports univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed zero-shot forecasting with real-time CPU inference. Built on a patch-based, decoder-only Transformer, CITRAS-FM introduces Shifted Attention into the cross-variate module to effectively exploit known covariates accessible throughout the forecast horizon. Moreover, to enable covariate-aware pretraining despite the scarcity of covariate-rich corpora, we propose CovSynth, which synthesizes realistic covariates from decomposed components of target series. Experiments on fev-bench, spanning 100 tasks across various settings, demonstrate that CITRAS-FM achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy among sub-10M TSFMs while delivering sub-0.1-second CPU inference, offering a strong balance between forecasting accuracy and real-time deployability.

</details>


### [361] [Boosting ECG Classification Performance by Pre-training with Synthesized Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10802)
*Naoki Nonaka,Jun Seita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于医学领域知识的高斯组合合成算法生成单导联II心电图数据，用于预训练DNN模型。实验表明，合成数据可提升三种异常心律（AF、AFLT、PVC）的分类性能，其中AFLT平均提升33.2%，且当真实数据规模较小时效果更显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学领域因隐私和疾病罕见性导致大规模数据获取困难，DNN训练面临数据稀缺问题，亟需探索基于领域知识的合成数据替代方案。

Method: 提出知识驱动的高斯组合合成算法，将每个心跳建模为P、Q、R、S、T高斯波形分量，生成AF、AFLT、PVC、WPW四类异常ECG的合成数据，并采用十种不同DNN架构进行合成到真实的迁移分类训练。

Result: 合成-真实训练对四种异常中的三种（AF、AFLT、PVC）分类性能有提升，AFLT平均增益最高达33.2%；增益在真实数据集规模较小时更为显著。

Conclusion: 基于领域知识的合成ECG可作为有效的预训练资源，尤其适用于真实数据有限或获取困难的场景。

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) typically require extensive datasets for effective training. In the medical domain, acquiring large-scale data is often challenging due to privacy concerns and the rarity of certain diseases. To address this data scarcity, we investigate the efficacy of training DNN models using synthetic data, generated based on domain-specific medical knowledge. Specifically, we develop a knowledge-driven Gaussian-composition synthesis algorithm for single-lead II ECGs, in which each heartbeat is represented by Gaussian-shaped P, Q, R, S, and T wave components. Using this simulator, we generate synthetic data for four abnormal electrocardiogram (ECG) classes: atrial fibrillation (AF), atrial flutter (AFLT), premature ventricular complex (PVC), and Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome (WPW). We evaluate the utility of this synthetic data by conducting abnormal ECG classification using ten different DNN architectures. Our results demonstrate that synthetic-to-real training improves classification performance for three of the four target abnormalities, with the largest architecture-averaged gain of $33.2\%$ observed for AFLT. Further analysis reveals that the performance enhancement from synthetic data is more pronounced with smaller real-world datasets. These findings suggest that domain-knowledge-based synthetic ECGs can serve as a useful pre-training resource, particularly in scenarios where real-world data are limited or difficult to obtain.

</details>


### [362] [The Emergence of Reproducibility and Generalizability in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.05264)
*Huijie Zhang,Jinfan Zhou,Yifu Lu,Minzhe Guo,Peng Wang,Liyue Shen,Qing Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现扩散模型存在“一致模型可复现性”现象：不同扩散模型使用相同初始噪声和确定性采样器时，会产生高度相似的输出。该现象存在于记忆化和泛化两种训练范式，并推广到条件生成、逆问题求解和模型微调等多种变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索并证实扩散模型中一个普遍但未被充分研究的现象——不同扩散模型在相同条件下会产生一致输出，揭示其背后的分布学习特性及训练数据规模的影响。

Method: 通过大量实验验证一致模型可复现性，分析记忆化与泛化两种训练范式下的表现，并扩展到条件扩散模型、逆问题求解和模型微调等变体。

Result: 不同扩散模型在相同噪声输入和确定性采样器下输出高度相似；该现象在记忆化和泛化两种训练范式中均存在；模型实际上受训练数据量影响学习不同分布；该性质可推广到多种扩散模型变体。

Conclusion: 该发现对扩散模型的训练效率、模型隐私和可控生成具有实际意义，并提出了若干值得未来探索的理论问题。

Abstract: In this work, we investigate an intriguing and prevalent phenomenon of diffusion models which we term as "consistent model reproducibility": given the same starting noise input and a deterministic sampler, different diffusion models often yield remarkably similar outputs. We confirm this phenomenon through comprehensive experiments, implying that different diffusion models consistently reach the same data distribution and scoring function regardless of diffusion model frameworks, model architectures, or training procedures. More strikingly, our further investigation implies that diffusion models are learning distinct distributions affected by the training data size. This is supported by the fact that the model reproducibility manifests in two distinct training regimes: (i) "memorization regime", where the diffusion model overfits to the training data distribution, and (ii) "generalization regime", where the model learns the underlying data distribution. Our study also finds that this valuable property generalizes to many variants of diffusion models, including those for conditional use, solving inverse problems, and model fine-tuning. Finally, our work raises numerous intriguing theoretical questions for future investigation and highlights practical implications regarding training efficiency, model privacy, and the controlled generation of diffusion models.

</details>


### [363] [K-Forcing: Joint Next-K-Token Decoding via Push-Forward Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10820)
*Zhiwei Tang,Yuanyu He,Yizheng Han,Wangbo Zhao,Jiasheng Tang,Fan Wang,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: K-Forcing 是一种前馈式语言建模范式，通过将自回归模型蒸馏为条件前馈映射，实现单次前向传播联合解码多个未来token（如k=4），在保持与标准AR服务基础设施兼容的同时，实现约2.4-3.5倍推理加速，仅带来轻微质量损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型逐token顺序解码导致推理内存受限且效率低下，现有加速方法（如投机解码、扩散语言模型）无法直接解决工业级部署中最关键的高负载批量服务场景。

Method: K-Forcing 将现有AR模型蒸馏为条件前馈映射，将独立均匀噪声变量转换为多个未来token的联合样本。通过渐进式自强制蒸馏训练，逐步扩展预测窗口，使学生模型紧密匹配AR教师模型的序列分布。

Result: 在LM1B和OpenWebText上使用标准因果Transformer主干，配置k=4时，在不同batch size下实现约2.4-3.5倍加速，质量退化程度适中。

Conclusion: K-Forcing 为在高负载真实部署场景下加速自回归生成提供了一条有前景的路径。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language modeling is the dominant paradigm for text generation, yet its sequential token-by-token decoding makes inference memory-bound and inefficient. Existing acceleration approaches, such as speculative decoding and diffusion language models, can yield speedups under certain conditions but do not directly address high-load batch serving--the scenario most critical for industrial-scale deployment. We introduce K-Forcing, a push-forward language modeling paradigm for joint next-k-token decoding. K-Forcing distills an existing AR model into a conditional push-forward mapping--one that transforms independent uniform noise variables into a joint sample of multiple future tokens in a single forward pass. This design preserves fixed-length outputs, reuses the AR teacher backbone, and remains compatible with standard AR serving infrastructure. We train this mapping via progressive self-forcing distillation, which gradually expands the prediction window while enabling the student to closely match the sequence distribution of the AR teacher. We evaluate K-Forcing on LM1B and OpenWebText using a standard causal Transformer backbone. When aggressively configured to generate k = 4 tokens per forward pass, K-Forcing delivers approximately 2.4-3.5x speedup across different batch sizes, while incurring modest quality degradation relative to its AR teacher. As inference increasingly dominates the lifetime compute cost of modern LLMs, K-Forcing offers a promising route toward accelerating AR generation under real-world high-load deployment.

</details>


### [364] [Breaking the Curse of Dimensionality: Diffusion Models Efficiently Learn Low-Dimensional Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.02426)
*Peng Wang,Huijie Zhang,Zekai Zhang,Siyi Chen,Yi Ma,Qing Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个数学框架，证明扩散模型能有效学习低维数据分布（如混合低秩高斯），样本复杂度与数据内在维度呈线性关系而非环境维度的指数关系，并建立了与子空间聚类问题的等价性，为可控图像生成提供理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解扩散模型学习数据分布的基本原理，特别是其如何在有限样本下避免维度灾难，为扩散模型的理论基础提供支撑。

Method: 将数据分布建模为混合低秩高斯分布，证明扩散模型训练目标等价于求解规范子空间聚类问题，每个子空间基对应高斯分量的低秩协方差。

Result: 样本复杂度与数据内在维度线性相关而非环境维度指数相关；在合成和真实图像数据集上观察到泛化中的相变现象；学习到的子空间基与图像语义属性对应。

Conclusion: 扩散模型能有效学习低维数据分布而不受维度灾难影响，该等价性为可控图像生成提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Despite their empirical success across a wide range of generative tasks, the fundamental principles underlying the ability of diffusion models to learn data distributions are poorly understood. In this work, we develop a new mathematical framework that explains how diffusion models can effectively learn low-dimensional distributions from a finite number of training samples without suffering from the curse of dimensionality. Specifically, motivated by the intrinsic low-dimensional structure of image data, we theoretically analyze a setting in which the data distribution is modeled as a mixture of low-rank Gaussians. Under suitable network parameterization, we show that optimizing the training objective of diffusion models is equivalent to solving the canonical subspace clustering problem over the training samples, where each subspace basis corresponds to the low-rank covariance of a Gaussian component. This equivalence allows us to show that the sample complexity for learning the underlying distribution scales linearly with the intrinsic dimension of the data, rather than exponentially with the ambient dimension. Our theoretical findings are further supported by empirical evidence that demonstrates phase transition phenomena in generalization on both synthetic and real-world image datasets. Moreover, we establish a correspondence between the learned subspace bases and semantic attributes of image data, providing a principled foundation for controllable image generation.

</details>


### [365] [Encoding the Euler Characteristic Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10824)
*Nello Blaser,Odin Hoff Gardaa,Lars M. Salbu,Elena Xinyi Wang,Bastian Rieck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Euler特征曲线的连续编码方法，通过为每个方向和顶点记录净Euler特征变化，生成token序列并由小型transformer处理。该方法在六个分类基准中五个提升了准确率，且性能提升主要归因于token化本身而非transformer容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Euler特征变换（ECT）通过离散化每个ECC来编码，这种固定方式引入了特定的归纳偏置。本文旨在提出一种连续编码方式，以更自然地表示ECT信息，并探索不同表示架构对性能的影响。

Method: 提出连续编码：对每个方向和每个顶点，记录归因于该顶点的净Euler特征变化，生成每个方向的token序列，由小型transformer映射为特征向量。将流程分为两个正交阶段：ECC编码器（方向内，曲线→固定长度向量）和ECT表示器（跨方向，聚合各方向向量）。研究了六种ECT表示架构，从结构无关的前馈基线到保持平面旋转等变性的卷积和复值模型。

Result: 在六个分类基准（点云、图、立方复形、网格）上，连续编码在五个数据集上提升了准确率。控制实验将性能增益归因于token化本身而非transformer容量。表示架构的影响小于编码方式，且归纳偏置的效果依赖于编码方式：前馈网络在连续编码下表现最佳，但在离散化下不如卷积架构鲁棒。

Conclusion: 连续编码优于传统离散化编码，且编码方式的选择比表示架构更为关键。不同的ECT表示架构在不同编码设置下表现不同，连续编码使简单的前馈网络也能取得优异效果。

Abstract: The Euler Characteristic Curve (ECC) records the Euler characteristic of a linearly embedded cell complex as a function of filtration height in a given direction, and the Euler Characteristic Transform (ECT) is the injective shape descriptor obtained by collecting ECCs over many directions. How the ECT is encoded for a neural network is itself an inductive bias, conventionally fixed by discretizing each ECC. We introduce a continuous encoding: for each direction and each vertex it records the net Euler-characteristic change attributed to that vertex, producing a per-direction token sequence that a small transformer maps to a feature vector. We separate the resulting pipeline into two stages on orthogonal axes: an ECC encoder that acts within each direction, mapping its curve to a fixed-length vector, and an ECT representation that acts across directions, aggregating the per-direction vectors into one. We study six ECT representation architectures spanning a range of inductive biases, from a structure-agnostic feedforward baseline to convolutional and complex-valued models that preserve equivariance under planar rotations. Across six classification benchmarks covering point clouds, graphs, cubical complexes, and meshes, the continuous encoding improves accuracy on five of six datasets, and control experiments attribute the gain to the tokenization itself rather than to the added transformer capacity. The representation architecture matters less than the encoding, and the payoff from its inductive biases depends on the encoding: a feedforward network performs best under continuous encoding but is less robust under discretization than convolutional architectures.

</details>


### [366] [Conditional Vendi Score: Prompt-Aware Diversity Evaluation for Generative AI Models and LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.02817)
*Mohammad Jalali,Azim Ospanov,Amin Gohari,Farzan Farnia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对文本引导生成模型，现有多样性指标（Vendi, RKE）无法区分提示引入的变异和模型自身产生的变异。本文提出条件版指标Conditional-Vendi和Conditional-RKE，基于正定矩阵的条件熵推导，能有效分离出模型诱导的多样性，并在文本到图像、图像描述和大语言模型任务中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型多样性评估指标（如Vendi和RKE）基于无条件生成场景设计，无法区分prompt带来的变异和模型自身产生的变异，导致在文本引导生成任务中评估失准。

Method: 从正定矩阵的条件熵出发，推导出Conditional-Vendi和Conditional-RKE两项指标。Conditional-RKE具有O(1/√n)收敛率；Conditional-Vendi采用截断谱近似实现可扩展且一致的估计。

Result: 在文本到图像、图像描述和大语言模型任务中，条件多样性指标能正确恢复真实多样性排序，并可用于引导扩散模型生成更多样化的样本。

Conclusion: 提出的条件多样性指标有效解决了文本引导生成场景下模型多样性评估的问题，理论性质良好且实用性强，开源代码可复现。

Abstract: Generative models guided by text prompts are widely evaluated for fidelity and prompt alignment, yet their ability to produce outputs remains underexplored. Existing diversity metrics such as Vendi and RKE, which are based on the von Neumann and Rényi entropies of kernel matrices, were developed for unconditional models and cannot distinguish prompt-induced from model-induced variability. We address this gap by introducing \textit{Conditional-Vendi} and \textit{Conditional-RKE}, diversity measures derived from the conditional entropy of positive semidefinite matrices. These scores isolate model-induced diversity in prompt-guided generation, with Conditional-RKE enjoying an $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ convergence rate. For Conditional-Vendi, we introduce a truncated-spectrum approximation that yields scalable and consistent estimates. Experiments on text-to-image, image-captioning, and LLM tasks show that the conditional scores recover ground-truth diversity orderings and can also guide diffusion models toward more diverse samples. The codebase is available at https://github.com/mjalali/conditional-vendi.

</details>


### [367] [MODIP: Efficient Model-Based Optimization for Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10825)
*Zakariae El Asri,Philippe Gratias-Quiquandon,Nicolas Thome,Olivier Sigaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MODIP提出一种基于世界模型和模型预测控制的扩散策略离线到在线微调框架，通过将MPC生成的高质量轨迹作为监督目标来微调扩散策略，避免了直接对扩散策略应用强化学习的复杂性，在D4RL和RoboMimic任务上取得了优于或媲美现有方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略在行为克隆中表现优异，但直接应用强化学习微调面临多步去噪过程带来的挑战，现有方法难以兼顾简单性和稳定性。

Method: 利用世界模型进行模型预测控制生成高质量轨迹，将其作为监督目标对扩散策略进行行为克隆式微调；采用终端状态值而非策略相关的状态-动作值来提高规划效率；使用策略无关的TD目标训练评论家以减少训练时间。

Result: 在D4RL（MuJoCo、Kitchen）和RoboMimic任务上，MODIP提升了扩散策略超越BC的性能，与扩散策略RL微调方法及TD-MPC2等强模型基基线相比具有竞争力或更优表现。

Conclusion: MODIP通过世界模型引导策略自适应，在保持行为克隆简单性和稳定性的同时，有效实现了扩散策略的离线到在线微调。

Abstract: Diffusion policies (DPs) have emerged as expressive policy representations for robot learning, often used with imitation learning methods such as behavioral cloning (BC). However, while their success has largely been confined to BC, direct reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning remains challenging because actions are generated through a multi-step denoising process. In this work, we propose MODIP, a framework for the offline-to-online fine-tuning of DPs. Rather than directly applying RL to the DPs, MODIP leverages a world model (WM) to guide policy adaptation and keeps the simplicity and stability of BC. We utilize model predictive control (MPC) to generate high-quality trajectories within the WM, and use them as supervised targets for fine-tuning the DP. To make MPC planning efficient, MODIP uses a terminal state value instead of a policy-dependent state-action value, reducing inference time. Additionally, MODIP trains critics with policy-independent TD targets, reducing training time. Experiments on D4RL (MuJoCo, Kitchen) and RoboMimic tasks show that MODIP improves diffusion policies beyond BC, and is competitive with or outperforms diffusion policy RL fine-tuning methods and strong model-based baselines such as TD-MPC2.

</details>


### [368] [Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning for Wildfire Danger Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25017)
*Spyros Kondylatos,Nikolas Papadopoulos,Gustau Camps-Valls,Ioannis Papoutsis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种不确定性感知的深度学习框架，通过联合捕捉认知不确定性（模型）和偶然不确定性（数据）来提升短期野火危险预测的准确性和可靠性。实验表明，该框架在次日预测中F1分数提升2.3%，期望校准误差降低2.1%，并验证了不确定性估计的实用价值，包括低置信度预测拒绝、生成带不确定性层的校准野火危险地图等。扩展至十天预测时，偶然不确定性随时间增加，而认知不确定性保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野火是严重的自然灾害，现有深度学习模型在野火危险预测中缺乏不确定性量化，导致可靠性不足，阻碍了其实际应用。

Method: 提出不确定性感知DL框架，联合建模认知不确定性（模型不确定性）和偶然不确定性（数据不确定性），用于短期野火危险预测。

Result: 次日预测：F1分数提升2.3%，期望校准误差降低2.1%；扩展至十天时，偶然不确定性随时间增加，认知不确定性保持稳定；两种不确定性在低不确定性情况下冗余，在高挑战条件下互补。

Conclusion: 所提不确定性感知框架显著提升了野火危险预测的准确性和可靠性，为开发可信赖的野火深度学习系统提供了重要支撑。

Abstract: Wildfires are among the most severe natural hazards, posing a significant threat to both humans and natural ecosystems. The growing risk of wildfires increases the demand for forecasting models that are not only accurate but also reliable. Deep Learning (DL) has shown promise in predicting wildfire danger; however, its adoption is hindered by concerns over the reliability of its predictions, some of which stem from the lack of uncertainty quantification. To address this challenge, we present an uncertainty-aware DL framework that jointly captures epistemic (model) and aleatoric (data) uncertainty to enhance short-term wildfire danger forecasting. In the next-day forecasting, our best-performing model improves the F1 Score by 2.3% and reduces the Expected Calibration Error by 2.1% compared to a deterministic baseline, enhancing both predictive skill and calibration. Our experiments confirm the reliability of the uncertainty estimates and illustrate their practical utility for decision support, including the identification of uncertainty thresholds for rejecting low-confidence predictions and the generation of well-calibrated wildfire danger maps with accompanying uncertainty layers. Extending the forecast horizon up to ten days, we observe that aleatoric uncertainty increases with time, showing greater variability in environmental conditions, while epistemic uncertainty remains stable. Finally, we show that although the two uncertainty types may be redundant in low-uncertainty cases, they provide complementary insights under more challenging conditions, underscoring the value of their joint modeling for robust wildfire danger prediction. In summary, our approach significantly improves the accuracy and reliability of wildfire danger forecasting, advancing the development of trustworthy wildfire DL systems.

</details>


### [369] [Geometrically Averaged Hard Target Updates for Linear Q-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10835)
*Donghwan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并分析了λ-目标更新机制，通过几何加权平均周期性目标更新映射，在线性Q-learning中实现从单周期更新到投影Q值迭代的连续插值，并利用切换系统模型研究了其稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 周期性硬目标更新是现代深度Q学习中最常见的稳定化手段之一，近期研究表明其在线性函数逼近的Q学习中也能提升稳定性。作者希望提出一种更通用的目标更新框架，连接单周期更新与投影Q值迭代，并分析其稳定性质。

Method: 提出λ-目标更新机制：对m-周期目标更新映射施加(1-λ)λ^{m-1}的几何权重进行平均。λ=0恢复单周期目标更新，λ↑1恢复投影Q值迭代。采用切换系统模型对线性Q-learning进行确定性版本的理论分析。

Result: 建立了λ-目标更新与周期性目标更新、投影Q值迭代之间的理论联系，通过切换系统框架分析了线性Q-learning在该机制下的稳定性，并指出该公式可延伸至随机强化学习场景。

Conclusion: λ-目标更新提供了一个统一的理论框架，将离散的周期性目标更新与连续的投影Q值迭代连接起来，为理解不同目标更新策略的稳定性提供了新的分析视角。

Abstract: Periodic hard target updates are among the most common stabilization devices in modern deep Q-learning. Recent studies suggest that target updates can improve stability in Q-learning with function approximation, including linear function approximation. We introduce and analyze the so-called $λ$-target update, obtained by averaging the $m$-periodic target update maps with $λ$-geometric weights $(1-λ)λ^{m-1}$, $λ\in [0,1]$. The endpoint $λ=0$ recovers the one-period target update, while the continuous endpoint $λ\uparrow1$ recovers projected Q-value iteration. We study this mechanism for Q-learning with linear function approximation, namely linear Q-learning, using a switching-system model and related tools. For clarity, the paper treats a deterministic version; the formulation extends to stochastic reinforcement-learning settings.

</details>


### [370] [When Do Autoregressive Sequence Models Forecast Physical Wavefields? A Controlled Study on Synthetic Seismograms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10868)
*Waleed Esmail,Stuart Russell,Jana Klinge,Alexander Kappes,Christine Thomas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过合成三分量地震图作为测试平台，系统研究了自回归滚动预测中相位漂移的稳定性问题。研究发现多令牌预测是稳定化的主导因素，而上下文比率存在关键阈值，残差失败主要表现为极性反转，指向相位感知目标函数是未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程自回归预测振荡物理信号（如地震图、引力波应变等）时，因果模型会积累误差导致相位漂移，而逐点指标无法检测该问题。因此需要系统性研究如何保持滚动预测的稳定性。

Method: 以SeismoGPT自回归预测器为模型，在合成三分量地震图上进行受控的架构内消融实验，通过自由运行滚动预测结合配对显著性检验，隔离各设计选择的贡献。采用多令牌预测、地平线嵌入混合预测头和跨地平线STFT幅度相干损失等方法。

Result: 多令牌预测是主导稳定因素，相比单令牌基线将中位数NCC提升0.040；地平线嵌入混合预测头和STFT幅度相干损失各带来微小但一致的增益。滚动泛化在上下文比率接近P-S间隔阈值时崩溃。主要残差失败为极性反转，幅度谱损失无法惩罚该现象。

Conclusion: 本文是对振荡波场滚动稳定性的受控研究，而非预测架构的基准测试。极性反转问题表明相位感知目标函数是提升稳定性的自然下一步方向。

Abstract: Long-horizon autoregressive forecasting of oscillatory physical signals, such as seismograms, gravitational-wave strain, and similar wavefields is limited by error accumulation: as a causal model is fed its own outputs over hundreds of steps, small per-step errors compound into phase drift that pointwise metrics fail to detect. We ask when such rollout stays stable, using synthetic three-component seismograms as a physically structured testbed and the \textsc{SeismoGPT} autoregressive forecaster as the model under study. Through controlled, intra-architecture ablations evaluated on free-running rollout with paired significance tests, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. Multi-token prediction is the dominant stabilizer, accounting for almost the entire improvement over a single-token baseline ($+0.040$ median NCC); a horizon-embedding hybrid prediction head and a cross-horizon STFT-magnitude coherence loss each add a small but consistent further gain. Performance depends sharply on a context-ratio threshold near one, roughly the full P-S interval of observed signal, below which rollout generalization collapses. The dominant residual failure is a polarity inversion that a magnitude-based spectral loss cannot, by construction, penalize, identifying phase-aware objectives as the natural next step. We frame this as a controlled study of rollout stability on oscillatory wavefields, not a benchmark of forecasting architectures.

</details>


### [371] [MMD Guidance: Training-Free Distribution Adaptation for Diffusion Models via Maximum Mean Discrepancy Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08379)
*Matina Mahdizadeh Sani,Nima Jamali,Mohammad Jalali,Farzan Farnia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MMD Guidance，一种无需训练的方法，通过最大均值差异（MMD）的梯度来引导扩散模型的反向采样过程，使生成样本与少量参考数据在分布上对齐，适用于域适应任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型生成的样本往往偏离用户特定的目标数据分布，尤其在域适应任务中只有少量参考样本且无法重训模型的情况下，现有推理时引导方法仅优化分类器似然等替代目标，未能直接对齐目标分布。

Method: 在扩散模型反向去噪过程中，将生成样本与参考数据集之间的最大均值差异（MMD）的梯度作为引导信号，注入采样轨迹。MMD具有从有限数据中可靠估计分布、低方差、可高效求导的特性。通过乘积核可扩展到条件生成模型的提示感知适应，并在潜在扩散模型的潜空间中高效应用。

Result: 在合成数据和真实世界基准测试中，MMD Guidance实现了分布对齐，同时保持了样本保真度。

Conclusion: MMD Guidance是一种无需训练、高效且有效的推理时引导机制，能够将预训练扩散模型的输出与用户特定目标分布对齐，特别适用于数据有限的域适应场景。

Abstract: Pre-trained diffusion models have emerged as powerful generative priors for both unconditional and conditional sample generation, yet their outputs often deviate from the characteristics of user-specific target data. Such mismatches are especially problematic in domain adaptation tasks, where only a few reference examples are available and retraining the diffusion model is infeasible. Existing inference-time guidance methods can adjust sampling trajectories, but they typically optimize surrogate objectives such as classifier likelihoods rather than directly aligning with the target distribution. We propose \emph{MMD Guidance}, a training-free mechanism that augments the reverse diffusion process with gradients of the \textit{Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)} between generated samples and a reference dataset. MMD provides reliable distributional estimates from limited data, exhibits low variance in practice, and is efficiently differentiable, which makes it particularly well-suited for the guidance task. Our framework naturally extends to prompt-aware adaptation in conditional generation models via product kernels. Also, it can be applied with computational efficiency in latent diffusion models (LDMs), since guidance is applied in the latent space of the LDM. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that MMD Guidance can achieve distributional alignment while preserving sample fidelity. The project code is available at github.com/matinamehdizadeh/MMD-Guidance.

</details>


### [372] [Optimal Post-Training Quantization Scales and Where to Find Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10890)
*Juan Amboage,Pablo Monteagudo-Lago,Ian Colbert,Giuseppe Franco,Nicholas Fraser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PiSO是一种利用校准数据精确优化逐通道量化尺度的后训练量化算法，通过将搜索空间划分为有限区间并寻找闭式解，在Llama和Qwen模型上显著提升了低比特量化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练量化方法中，定义量化网格的缩放因子通常采用简单的无数据启发式方法，缺乏对数据信息的利用，导致量化精度受限，尤其在低比特场景下性能下降明显。

Method: 提出PiSO算法，将缩放因子的搜索空间划分为有限个区间，在每个区间上目标函数存在闭式最小化解，从而实现逐通道权重尺度的精确高效优化；进一步扩展到逐组量化，并与误差校正策略交织迭代。

Result: 在Llama和Qwen系列模型上，不同模型规模和目标比特宽度下，PiSO在困惑度和零样本准确率上均取得一致性提升；目标比特宽度越窄，量化越困难时，收益越显著。

Conclusion: PiSO通过数据驱动的分区间精确优化方法，有效提升了低比特量化的性能，且可与误差校正方法协同工作，为后训练量化提供了一种高效且可扩展的尺度优化方案。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models by mapping weights to low-bit representations. The scaling factor that defines the quantization grid is typically chosen using simple, data-free heuristics. In this work, we present PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), an algorithm that leverages calibration data to compute the optimal channel-wise weight scales exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization. PiSO partitions the scale search space into finitely many intervals on which the objective admits a closed-form minimizer. We extend PiSO to group-wise quantization via principled heuristics and propose effective strategies for interleaving scale optimization with error correction. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models across multiple model sizes and target weight bit-widths demonstrate consistent improvements in perplexity and downstream zero-shot accuracy, both standalone and combined with error correction. In particular, we observe increased benefits as the target bit-width narrows and quantization becomes more challenging.

</details>


### [373] [Flash-GMM: A Memory-Efficient Kernel for Scalable Soft Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10896)
*Gal Bloch,Ariel Gera,Matan Orbach,Ohad Eytan,Assaf Toledo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Flash-GMM是一个融合的Triton内核，用于在单次GPU pass中高效计算大规模高斯混合模型（GMM），相比现有实现实现20倍加速，并支持比之前大100倍以上的数据集训练。将其集成到IVF粗量化器中用于近似最近邻（ANN）搜索，表明软GMM聚类可以替代k-means，达到固定召回率目标时减少1.7倍距离计算，或在相同计算成本下召回率提升2-12个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GMM实现需要将完整的责任矩阵实例化到GPU内存中，导致内存占用巨大，限制了可处理的数据规模。同时，软聚类方法（如GMM）在ANN搜索中的潜力未被充分利用。

Method: 提出Flash-GMM融合Triton内核，避免在GPU内存中物化完整责任矩阵；将GMM作为IVF粗量化器的drop-in替换，利用GMM责任分数将边界向量分配到多个聚类。

Result: 实现20倍加速，支持100倍更大数据集；在ANN搜索中，达到固定召回率目标时减少1.7倍距离计算，或在相同计算成本下召回率提升2-12个点。

Conclusion: 软GMM聚类可以高效替代k-means用于ANN搜索中的粗量化，且通过多分配策略进一步提升搜索性能。内核已作为开源项目发布。

Abstract: We present \textbf{Flash-GMM}, a fused Triton kernel for efficient computation of Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) over large-scale data in a single GPU pass. By eliminating the need to materialize the full responsibility matrix in GPU memory, Flash-GMM achieves a \textbf{20$\times$} speedup over existing implementations and enables training on datasets more than \textbf{100$\times$} larger than previously feasible on one device. To demonstrate its impact, we integrate Flash-GMM into the IVF coarse quantizer for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search. We show that soft GMM clustering is now a viable drop-in replacement for $k$-means, and that GMM responsibilities can be leveraged to assign border vectors to multiple clusters. Our approach reaches fixed recall targets with up to $1.7\times$ fewer distance computations, or equivalently, yields $+2$--$12$ recall@10 at matched computational cost. We release the kernel as an open-source project.

</details>


### [374] [Conservation Laws from Data Symmetry in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10913)
*Jakob Galley,Vahid Shahverdi,Axel Flinth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了训练数据的内在对称性是否会在神经网络的梯度流训练过程中导致守恒量。结果表明，对于解析且非多项式的损失函数，数据对称性通常不会产生额外的守恒量；而对于均方误差（MSE）损失，数据增强在某些情况下会产生额外的守恒量。作者利用“可张量化网络”框架描述了这一现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究训练数据的对称性（如数据增强）是否在神经网络梯度流训练中产生守恒量（即训练过程中保持不变的量），从而理解对称性对训练动态的影响。

Method: 理论分析：假设损失函数为解析且非多项式，证明数据对称性一般不产生额外守恒量；针对MSE损失，发现数据增强可产生额外守恒量；提出“可张量化网络”框架（包括线性网络、多项式网络及Lightning Attention等架构）来描述该现象。

Result: 对于解析非多项式损失函数，数据对称性不产生额外的守恒量；对于MSE损失，数据增强在某些情况下会产生额外的守恒量。

Conclusion: 数据对称性对神经网络训练动态的影响取决于损失函数类型：非解析非多项式损失下无额外守恒量，而MSE损失下数据增强可引入额外守恒量，这通过可张量化网络框架得以描述。

Abstract: We explore whether intrinsic symmetries of the training data lead to conserved quantities during gradient-flow training of neural networks. Under the assumption that the loss function is analytic and non-polynomial, we prove that data symmetries generically do not induce any additional integrals of motion. For mean squared error (MSE) loss, on the other hand, there are situations in which data augmentation yields extra conserved quantities. We build a framework, utilizing \emph{tensorizable networks} to describe this phenomenon. Tensorizable networks are a family of architectures whose dependence on parameters and inputs can be separated using an intermediate representation. They include linear and polynomial networks, as well as Lightning Attention.

</details>


### [375] [Recoverable but Not Stationary:Local Linear Structures in Weights and Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10929)
*Irina Piontkovskaia,Sergey Nikolenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了预训练模型中的线性结构，发现存在局部低秩任务梯度结构，但拒绝了固定任务平面假设；随机搜索在极高维度下仍然有效；参数扰动与激活引导之间存在可量化的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究任务向量、LoRA、激活引导和随机搜索等方法所依赖的线性方向结构是否真实存在及其存在的尺度。

Method: 在合成多任务Transformer、DistilGPT-2/GPT-2的LoRA适配器上进行实验，结合高斯局部线性定理进行随机搜索理论分析，并测量参数扰动与激活引导之间的余弦相似度。

Result: 发现了强局部低秩任务梯度结构，但静态基会遗漏恢复方向且有用基在100步内显著漂移；轨迹前缀基可捕获77%的LoRA恢复位移；单步梯度产生的激活偏移与CAA引导向量的余弦相似度为0.58。

Conclusion: 训练网络中的线性结构并非全局任务方向，而是演化的局部几何结构，该结构在参数空间和激活空间之间部分持久存在。

Abstract: Task vectors, LoRA, activation steering, and random search around pretrained weights all suggest that learned behaviour can be controlled by linear directions. We ask which linear structures actually exist and on what scale. In a synthetic multitask transformer and LoRA adapters on DistilGPT-2 / GPT-2 we find strong local low-rank task-gradient structure but reject the fixed-task-plane hypothesis: static bases miss the recovery direction, and the useful basis drifts substantially within 100 steps. However, the first recovery updates form a trajectory-prefix basis capturing 77% of the LoRA recovery displacement. We develop random search theory with a Gaussian local-linear theorem that justifies the effectiveness of random parameter search even in very high dimensions. We also study the relation between parameter perturbations and activation steering: a single gradient step produces an activation shift with 0.58 cosine to a labelled-contrast CAA steering vector, with a similar steering effect on Qwen-0.5B BoolQ statements. We validate our results with experiments on synthetic Transformers and LLMs. Our results suggest that linear structures in trained networks are not global task directions, but evolving local geometries that partially persist across parameter and activation spaces.

</details>


### [376] [CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10935)
*Xuezhen Xie,Zhiqiang Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现多token预测加速方法存在“头-主干竞争”架构缺陷，提出Backbone-as-Architect设计原则和CLP轻量层，在Qwen2.5模型上实现零质量损失的1.14x-1.29x加速，并指出MTP头预测精度是加速的关键约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MTP加速方法存在根本性架构缺陷：用于第一个token的MTP头与主干模型的LM头之间存在竞争，导致预测被接受时质量严重下降（重复、不连贯）。作者将此识别为“头-主干竞争”，是先前方法失败的根源。

Method: 提出Backbone-as-Architect设计原则：主干LM头始终生成第一个token，MTP头仅负责后续token。基于此提出CLP（搭配-长度预测器），一个轻量级跨度的决策层，仅用单线性层（4.6K-7.7K参数）预测解码时安全接受多少额外token，替代先前百万参数的门控网络。

Result: 在Qwen2.5（0.5B/1.5B/7B）上，CLP实现1.20x-1.29x（1.5B）和1.14x-1.20x（7B）加速，重复率<0.02%（零质量退化）；而门控方法仅1.07x加速或重复率>0.5%。更短的预测视野（k=2）在大模型上恢复24%的MTP头精度。

Conclusion: MTP头预测精度是加速的绑定约束，Backbone-as-Architect和CLP解决了架构缺陷，为零质量损失的推测解码建立了清晰的改进路线图。

Abstract: Large language model inference is bottlenecked by autoregressive decoding, where each token requires a full forward pass. Multi-token prediction (MTP) offers a promising acceleration path, but existing approaches suffer from a fundamental architectural flaw: the MTP head for the first token competes with the backbone's own language model (LM) head, leading to severe quality degradation when predictions are accepted. We identify this head-backbone competition as the root cause of repetitive and incoherent outputs in prior MTP-based acceleration methods. To address this, we propose Backbone-as-Architect, a design principle where the backbone LM head always generates the first token, and MTP heads are responsible only for subsequent tokens. Building on this principle, we introduce CLP (Collocation-Length Predictor), a lightweight span-level decision layer that predicts how many additional tokens can be safely accepted at each decoding step. CLP uses only a single linear layer (4.6K--7.7K parameters), replacing the over-engineered 1M-parameter gate networks used in prior work. Experiments on Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, 7B) show that CLP achieves 1.20x--1.29x speedup on 1.5B and 1.14x--1.20x on 7B, with zero quality degradation (repetition ratio < 0.02), while gate-based approaches fail to accelerate (1.07x) or produce severely degraded outputs (repetition ratio > 0.5%). We further demonstrate that shorter prediction horizons (k=2) recover 24% higher MTP head accuracy on large models, establishing a scaling-aware design principle. We identify MTP head prediction accuracy as the binding constraint on acceleration and establish a clear roadmap for future improvements.

</details>


### [377] [A Systematic Approach for Selecting Trajectories for Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10938)
*Adam Nordling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了五种轨迹数据增强选择策略（Outlierness、Diversity、Representativeness、Uncertainty和Random），发现系统性策略（尤其是Outlierness和Uncertainty）在稀疏数据上优于随机基线，但在高质量密集数据中增强可能带来噪声，且高速度域存在物理局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹数据增强方法虽采用几何扰动，但依赖随机选择，缺乏对"哪些轨迹应被增强"这一关键问题的系统性理解，需要填补这一空白以最大化增强效益。

Method: 提出系统性框架，评估五种选择策略（Outlierness、Diversity、Representativeness、Uncertainty、Random），在四个数据集（Foxes、Starkey、AIS、Car）上使用线性和非线性模型进行测试，并整合Optuna超参数优化循环。

Result: 系统性策略并非通用解决方案，但在密集数据中（尤其是Outlierness和Uncertainty）比随机基线更稳定、性能退化更少。UMAP可视化显示系统性增强可修复稀疏数据拓扑碎片，但在高质量密集数据中会引入噪声。高速度域中标准扰动会导致特征空间发散。

Conclusion: 轨迹数据增强的价值具有条件性：在稀疏数据中有益，在高质量密集数据中可能适得其反；系统性选择策略优于随机基线，但非万能方案。

Abstract: Trajectory data augmentation is a promising approach to mitigate data scarcity in machine learning applications, but its utility has been limited by the complexity of preserving spatio-temporal coherence. Although prior work demonstrated the viability of geometric perturbation, it relied on naive random selection, leaving a critical gap in understanding which trajectories should be augmented for maximal benefit. This thesis addresses this gap by developing a systematic and scalable framework to evaluate five systematic selection strategies: Outlierness, Diversity, Representativeness, Uncertainty, and Random selection. These strategies were rigorously tested across four datasets covering animal behavior (Foxes and Starkey), maritime traffic (AIS), and urban traffic (Car) using a suite of linear and non-linear machine learning models. As part of this evaluation, an Optuna-based hyperparameter optimization loop was integrated to empirically identify the best-performing augmentation parameters for each dataset within the explored search space. The results indicate that, while systematic selection is not a universal solution, it offers distinct advantages over the random baseline. Systematic strategies, particularly Outlierness and Uncertainty, demonstrated higher stability and were less prone to performance degradation observed with random sampling in dense datasets. However, the findings also reveal that the value of augmentation is strictly conditional. Visual analysis via UMAP demonstrates that while systematic augmentation successfully repairs topological fragmentation in sparse datasets, it can act as a corrupting noise signal in high-quality, dense datasets. Furthermore, the study identified physical limitations in high-velocity domains, where standard perturbation techniques lead to divergence in feature space...

</details>


### [378] [Express Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10944)
*Albert Gong,Annabelle Michael Carrell,Raaz Dwivedi,Lester Mackey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Express工具，将非因果注意力近似转换为因果近似，结合Thinformer实现最优因果注意力保证（log^{3/2}(n)/s误差，O(s)内存，O(s²log²(n))压缩开销），通过I/O感知Triton实现超越FlashAttention 2，并解决LM流程中四个资源瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果注意力近似方法保证不足，需要一种能将非因果注意力近似转化为因果近似且保持理论保证的工具，以提升语言建模管线效率。

Method: 提出Express工具，实现非因果到因果注意力的转换并保持近似保证；与Thinformer结合；开发I/O感知的Triton实现。

Result: 达到log^{3/2}(n)/s近似误差，仅需O(s)内存和O(s²log²(n))压缩开销；实现超越FlashAttention 2的加速；克服长上下文预填充、KV缓存压缩、长形式内存/计算约束解码四个瓶颈。

Conclusion: Express是一种高效的理论保证因果注意力近似工具，在实际系统中显著加速并解决多个LM部署瓶颈。

Abstract: We introduce a new tool, Express, for converting a non-causal attention approximation into a causal approximation with matching approximation guarantees. When combined with the state-of-the-art Thinformer approximation, Express improves upon the best known causal attention guarantees, delivering $\log^{3/2}(n)/s$ approximation error with only $O(s)$ memory and $O(s^2 \log^2(n))$ compression overhead for a sequence of length $n$. We pair these developments with an efficient I/O-aware Triton implementation, demonstrate substantial speedups over FlashAttention 2, and use Express to overcome four resource bottlenecks in the language modeling pipeline: long-context prefill, KV cache compression, long-form memory-constrained decoding, and long-form compute-constrained decoding.

</details>


### [379] [Population-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Particle Flow for Bayesian Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10959)
*Batu Candan,Simone Servadio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出种群感知的物理信息神经粒子流（PA-PINPF），通过在粒子更新中引入排列不变的Deep Sets全粒子集表示，使粒子运输决策能够感知整体粒子种群状态。研究了两种编码器：PA-PINPF-State（总结粒子状态）和PA-PINPF-Feature（总结完整局部物理信息特征向量），后者能同时表示粒子云几何和种群级贝叶斯运输几何。实验表明种群感知变体优于原始逐粒子PINPF，特征种群编码性能最强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PINPF速度模型独立处理每个粒子，其运输决策没有显式地以经验粒子种群为条件，导致缺乏全局信息指导。

Method: 在粒子更新中引入排列不变的Deep Sets表示全粒子集，设计两种种群编码器：State编码器总结粒子状态，Feature编码器总结包含位置、伪时间、测量信息、似然值和分数信息的完整局部物理信息特征向量。保留无监督物理信息残差目标，无需真实后验样本训练。

Result: 在距离测量任务和非线性到达时间差后验运输实验中，两种种群感知变体均优于逐粒子PINPF，其中特征种群编码性能最强。

Conclusion: 种群级物理特征为学习贝叶斯粒子运输提供了有用的全局信息。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural particle flow (PINPF) learns a deterministic transport field that moves particles from a prior distribution toward a Bayesian posterior while enforcing the governing probability-evolution equation. However, the standard PINPF velocity model processes particles independently and therefore does not explicitly condition its transport decisions on the empirical particle population. This paper introduces population-aware PINPF (PA-PINPF), which augments each particle update with a permutation-invariant Deep Sets representation of the full particle set. We investigate two population encoders. PA-PINPF-State summarizes the particle states, whereas PA-PINPF-Feature summarizes the complete local physics-informed feature vectors, including particle position, pseudo-time, measurement information, likelihood values, and score information. The latter allows the population context to represent not only particle-cloud geometry, but also the population-level Bayesian transport geometry. The methods retain the original unsupervised physics-informed residual objective and require no ground-truth posterior samples during training. Experiments on range-measurement tasks and nonlinear time-difference-of-arrival posterior transport demonstrate that both population-aware variants improve over particle-wise PINPF, while feature-population encoding provides the strongest performance. These results show that population-level physics features provide useful global information for learned Bayesian particle transport.

</details>


### [380] [Beyond Uniform Token-Level Trust Region in LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10968)
*Renjie Mao,Xiangxin Zhou,Lvfang Tao,Yixin Ding,Yu Shi,Yongguang Lin,Yuheng Wu,Honglin Zhu,Qian Qiu,Wenxi Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CPPO提出了一种基于累积前缀散度的策略优化方法，通过在token层面引入位置加权阈值和累积前缀预算，解决了统一阈值在自回归生成中忽略不对称性和累积漂移的问题，提高了推理准确性和训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PPO风格的信任域机制在token层面采用位置无关的统一阈值，这与自回归生成的两个关键特性相冲突：1) 自回归不对称性——早期偏差会产生累积序列漂移，导致静态阈值对早期发散约束不足而对后期探索过度约束；2) 累积前缀漂移——独立评估token级发散忽略了历史前缀的累积偏差。

Method: CPPO通过两种耦合机制实现token级别的掩码规则：1) 位置加权阈值——对早期位置施加更严格限制（其影响持续更长），放松后期token约束；2) 累积前缀预算——追踪历史偏差，动态限制进一步token级偏差，防止沿前缀的复合错误。

Result: 实验表明CPPO在不同模型规模下均能提升训练稳定性和推理准确性。

Conclusion: CPPO通过对齐有限时域策略改进界的位置感知约束机制，有效解决统一阈值在自回归生成中的固有问题，是实现更稳定、更准确LLM推理训练的有效方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become standard for improving LLM reasoning. However, existing PPO-style trust-region mechanisms remain position-agnostic by enforcing uniform thresholds across all tokens independently. This pointwise treatment conflicts with autoregressive generation in two critical ways. First, uniform thresholds ignore autoregressive asymmetry. Early-stage deviations produce compounding sequence-level drift, causing static thresholds to under-regulate early divergence and excessively constrain late-stage exploration. Second, evaluating token-level divergence in isolation overlooks cumulative prefix drift, granting the same divergence allowance regardless of how far the conditioning history has already deviated from the rollout policy. To address this limitation, we propose CPPO (Cumulative Prefix-divergence Policy Optimization), a token-level masking rule that aligns updates with a finite-horizon policy-improvement bound via two coupled mechanisms. First, a position-weighted threshold imposes stricter limits at early positions whose effects persist longer, relaxing constraints for late-stage tokens. Second, a cumulative prefix budget tracks historical deviations, dynamically restricting further token-level deviation to prevent compounding errors along the prefix. Empirically, CPPO enhances training stability and significantly improves reasoning accuracy across various model scales.

</details>


### [381] [Learning Doubly Sparse Explicitly Conditioned Transforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10975)
*Tudor Pistol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将固定典型变换与数据自适应稀疏成分相结合的结构化显式条件化变换学习方法，在保持快速稳定分析变换优势的同时引入可控自适应性，在双重稀疏变换学习问题上取得了最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分析变换（如DFT、DCT）虽提供高效算法和鲁棒稀疏表示，但基于固定先验假设，无法精确捕捉更严格信号类别的特定结构；而数据自适应学习变换虽能减少残差项，但需要在泛化能力和最小化近似误差之间取得平衡。条件数被证明是该背景下的良好度量指标。

Method: 将结构化显式条件化变换表示为固定典型矩阵与可细化数据自适应稀疏分量的乘积；在不精确近端方法框架下推导算法的动机，利用新导出的闭式投影算子。

Result: 在双重稀疏变换学习问题上取得了最优结果；与密集变体相比性能相当，但计算成本显著降低，有时收敛更快且能更好地避免不良局部最小值。

Conclusion: 该方法在保持分析变换快速稳定优势的同时引入了可控的数据自适应性，且该特定公式化具有新颖性，此前文献中未见相关研究。

Abstract: Finding convenient spaces in which certain hypotheses regarding an assumed sparse structure of natural signals hold true has become a desirable result in recent research, its implications being reflected in areas such as data compression, noise reduction and feature extraction. While the extensively used analytical transforms, such as DFT or DCT, already provide efficient algorithms and robust sparse representations, they assume a fixed prior about the data, failing to accurately capture the specific structure of more restrictive classes of signals. To address this, the concept of a data-adaptive, learnt transform has been introduced in the literature, allowing for the reduction of a residual term in the transform domain. More recent studies have shown that the condition number serves as a good metric in this context, where the desired outcome alternates between a generalizing tendency and one that achieves minimal approximation error. Motivated by these considerations, we introduce the learning of a structured, explicitly conditioned transform formulated as the product of a fixed canonical matrix and a refining data-adaptive sparse component. This approach seeks to preserve the advantages of fast and stable analytical transforms, while introducing controllable adaptivity to the data. No references that concern this specific formulation have been identified so far, indicating its novelty. The proposed algorithm is motivated within the framework of inexact proximal methods, leveraging a newly derived closed-form projection operator. Empirical observations demonstrate state-of-the-art results on the doubly sparse transform learning problem and comparable performance with its dense variant at significantly lower computational costs and sometimes faster convergence and better avoidance of bad local minima.

</details>


### [382] [Data-Driven Runway and Taxiway Exits Prediction of Landing Aircraft: A Case Study at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11017)
*Alex Porcayo,Yutian Pang,Maria Thomas,John-Paul Clarke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究针对亚特兰大机场(ATL)的到达滑入决策，提出两阶段数据驱动决策辅助工具：第一阶段预测跑道出口选择，第二阶段预测是否穿越活跃起飞跑道或使用端绕滑行道。使用XGBoost和LightGBM等模型，阶段一准确率0.86-0.89，阶段二0.70-0.74，进近速度是出口选择的关键特征，出发率、穿越率等是跑道穿越预测的关键特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机场场面运行日益成为高吞吐量枢纽机场性能的瓶颈，需要数据驱动的决策辅助工具来提升管制员情景意识和运行效率。

Method: 提出两阶段预测框架：阶段一预测到达飞机选择的跑道出口，阶段二预测飞机是否会穿越活跃起飞跑道或使用端绕滑行道。使用ASDE-X场面轨迹数据、飞机特性、停机位目的地、短时交通流率和天气数据，对九种分类器（包括随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost）进行基准测试，并采用t-SNE和UMAP进行特征空间分析。

Result: XGBoost和LightGBM优于随机森林。阶段一准确率0.86-0.89，宏F1得分0.40-0.50；阶段二准确率0.70-0.74，宏F1得分0.28-0.55。进近速度是出口选择的主要驱动因素，出发率、穿越率、停机位目的地和所选出口是跑道穿越vs端绕路由的最强预测因子。少数类因特征空间重叠而难以预测。

Conclusion: 该框架通过提供校准的、可解释的预测来支持管制员情景意识，同时将最终路由决策的责任保留给人类管制员。

Abstract: Airport surface operations increasingly constrain performance at high-throughput hubs. This study examines arrival taxi-in decisions at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (KATL) and proposes a two-stage, data-driven decision aid that mirrors controller workflow. Stage I predicts the runway exit selected by an arriving aircraft. Stage II predicts whether, given that exit, the aircraft will cross the active departure runway at a designated point or use the end-around taxiway. Models are trained using ASDE-X surface trajectories, aircraft characteristics, ramp destinations, short-horizon traffic rates, and weather across multiple look-back windows. We benchmark nine classifiers, including Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, and evaluate accuracy, macro-F1, precision-recall behavior, confusion matrices, Brier score, and Expected Calibration Error. Across east and west flows, XGBoost and LightGBM outperform Random Forest. Stage I achieves 0.86-0.89 accuracy with macro-F1 scores of 0.40-0.50, while Stage II achieves 0.70-0.74 accuracy with macro-F1 scores of 0.28-0.55. Feature-importance analysis shows that approach speed is the main driver of exit choice. Departure rate, crossing rate, ramp destination, and, for west flow, the selected exit are the strongest predictors of crossing versus end-around routing. Minority classes remain harder to predict because of feature-space overlap, as shown by t-SNE and UMAP analyses. The proposed framework supports controller situational awareness through calibrated, explainable predictions while preserving human responsibility for final routing decisions.

</details>


### [383] [Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11025)
*Bowen Ping,Xiangxin Zhou,Penghui Qi,Minnan Luo,Liefeng Bo,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Flow-DPPO提出用精确KL散度约束替代PPO中的比率裁剪，解决流匹配模型在线强化学习中的策略约束不匹配问题，在奖励、KL效率、灾难性遗忘和多目标优化上超越Flow-GRPO等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Flow-GRPO等方法将去噪过程建模为MDP并套用PPO的比率裁剪策略约束，但比率裁剪对流模型结构上不合适：新旧策略的概率比是单样本有噪声估计，导致轨迹某些区域过约束、某些区域欠约束。

Method: 提出Flow-DPPO，用散度近端约束替代比率裁剪。核心洞察是流模型每步策略为高斯分布，可精确廉价计算新旧策略间的KL散度。采用非对称散度掩码，仅当更新同时偏离信任区域且违反散度阈值时才阻止梯度更新。

Result: Flow-DPPO在更高奖励、更好KL近端效率、缓解灾难性遗忘、促进平衡多目标优化上表现优异，且支持多轮稳定训练（此时比率裁剪退化）。

Conclusion: 比率裁剪对流模型不适用，基于精确KL散度的近端约束是更优替代方案，Flow-DPPO为流模型的在线RL训练提供了更稳定高效的范式。

Abstract: Recent work has demonstrated that online reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the quality and alignment of flow matching models for image and video generation. Methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS cast the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process and apply PPO-style ratio clipping to enforce a trust region. However, we argue that ratio clipping is structurally ill-suited for flow models: the probability ratio between new and old policies is a noisy, single-sample estimate of the true policy divergence, leading to over-constraining in some regions of the trajectory and under-constraining in others. We propose Flow-DPPO (Flow Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization), which replaces ratio clipping with a divergence proximal constraint. A key observation is that the per-step policy in flow models is Gaussian, enabling exact and cheap computation of the KL divergence between old and new policies. Flow-DPPO employs an asymmetric divergence mask that blocks gradient updates only when they simultaneously move away from the trusted region and violate the divergence threshold. Experiments show that Flow-DPPO achieves higher rewards with better KL-proximal efficiency, alleviates catastrophic forgetting, promotes balanced multi-objective optimization, and enables stable multi-epoch training where ratio clipping degrades. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/UniRL/tree/main/FlowDPPO.

</details>


### [384] [AuRA: Internalizing Audio Understanding into LLMs as LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11033)
*Bo Cheng,Lei Shi,Zhanyu Ma,Yuan Wu,Jun Xu,Jiuchong Gao,Jinghua Hao,Renqing He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AuRA是一种通过层间蒸馏将ASR编码器的音频编码能力内化到LLM轻量级适配中的方法，实现了更紧密的语音-语言联合建模和高效的并行端到端推理，在多个基准上优于级联系统和语音到LLM适配基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将大语言模型扩展到语音输入的方法（级联ASR-LLM流水线、端到端语音语言模型、桥接/蒸馏适配）存在转录接口延迟、多模态训练成本高或语音-语言顺序耦合等问题，需要一种既能复用预训练组件又能实现紧密语音-语言联合建模的高效方法。

Method: 将同一语音输入同时送入ASR编码器（教师）和LoRA适配的LLM（学生），通过轻量级音频嵌入层，利用层间蒸馏对齐学生与教师的隐藏状态，将语音表示内化到LLM的轻量级适配中，实现并行端到端推理。

Result: 在多个语音语言基准上，AuRA在有效性和效率方面均持续优于级联系统、语音到LLM适配基线以及大规模语音语言和多模态模型。

Conclusion: AuRA通过蒸馏方式实现语音能力的轻量级内化，避免了大规模多模态训练，同时实现了更紧密的语音-语言联合建模和高效的并行端到端推理。

Abstract: Recent efforts to extend large language models (LLMs) to speech inputs typically rely on cascaded ASR-LLM pipelines, end-to-end speech-language models, or bridge/distillation-based adaptation. While these routes respectively reuse strong pretrained components, enable native speech-language interaction, or offer lightweight adaptation, they often suffer from transcript-interface latency, costly multimodal training, or sequential speech-language coupling. To address these limitations, we present AuRA, a method that distills audio encoding capability into the LLM. Specifically, AuRA feeds the same speech input to an ASR encoder (as a teacher) and a LoRA-adapted LLM (as a student) through a lightweight audio embedding layer, and uses layer-wise distillation to align the student's hidden states with corresponding teacher representations, thereby internalizing speech representations into lightweight LLM-side adaptations. Compared with cascaded and serial bridge methods, AuRA enables tighter speech-language joint modeling and efficient parallel end-to-end inference, while also reusing pretrained speech and language models rather than requiring large-scale multimodal training. On multiple speech-language benchmarks, AuRA consistently outperforms cascaded systems, speech-to-LLM adaptation baselines, and large-scale speech-language and multimodal models in both effectiveness and efficiency.

</details>


### [385] [Flexible Kernels for Protein Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11057)
*Martin Jankowiak,Yerdos Ordabayev,Rudraksh Tuwani,Henry N. Ward,Hunter Nisonoff,James M. McFarland,Gevorg Grigoryan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一类利用进化替代矩阵和局部线性性的序列核，用于高斯过程模型，在蛋白质属性预测中比基于基础模型嵌入的方法更高效，并通过学习结构感知的替代矩阵融入结构信息，在多任务学习中显著优于局部监督学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏实验数据预测蛋白质结合亲和力和热稳定性等属性对蛋白质设计至关重要，但目前仍面临显著挑战，现有方法数据效率不足。

Method: 提出一类序列核，利用进化替代矩阵和局部线性性；通过高斯过程构建数据高效的蛋白质属性景观模型；进一步学习结构感知的替代矩阵，融入基础模型的结构信息。

Result: 所提出的序列核方法在蛋白质属性预测中频繁优于基于基础模型嵌入的替代方案；结构条件核在多任务学习中显著优于局部监督学习方法。

Conclusion: 基于进化替代矩阵和局部线性性的序列核结合高斯过程，为从稀疏数据预测蛋白质属性提供了一种数据高效且可融入结构信息的有效框架。

Abstract: Despite its importance to applications in protein design, predicting protein properties like binding affinity and thermostability from sparse experimental data remains a significant challenge. Accordingly, we introduce a class of sequence kernels that exploit evolutionary substitution matrices as well as local linearity and demonstrate that the resulting Gaussian processes provide data-efficient models of protein property landscapes, frequently outperforming alternatives that rely on foundation model embeddings. Furthermore--by learning what are in effect structure-aware substitution matrices--we show that our kernels can readily incorporate structural information from foundation models. We demonstrate that these structure-conditioned kernels are well suited to multi-task learning across multiple protein property landscapes and can decisively outperform local supervised learning methods.

</details>


### [386] [Exploring the Design Space of Reward Backpropagation for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11075)
*Ruoyu Wang,Boye Niu,Xiangxin Zhou,Yushi Huang,Tongliang Liu,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowBP提出统一代理轨迹框架解决文本到图像流匹配模型中的直接奖励反向传播两大问题（全轨迹存储不可行、梯度膨胀），通过无梯度缓存 rollout 和轻量级反向代理解耦采样与优化，其中 FlowBP-Sparse/Bridge/Lagrange 三种变体在 SD3.5-M、FLUX.1-dev、FLUX.2-Klein-base 上多数指标优于直接梯度基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接奖励反向传播在文本到图像流匹配模型中对齐人类偏好虽样本高效，但面临两大病理：全采样轨迹激活值无法在现代模型规模下存储，以及跨步链式雅可比乘积导致早期索引处奖励梯度膨胀。现有Connector方法（如LeapAlign）通过短固定路径替代全反向轨迹，但短路径对全长rollout的近似精度（尤其长区间）决定了梯度质量。

Method: FlowBP将反向轨迹本身作为设计对象，构建统一代理轨迹框架：1) 无梯度缓存 rollout 用于采样；2) 从缓存和选择性重传速度中构建轻量级反向代理。框架解耦四个选择维度：奖励模型输入、活跃集、积分权重、桥耦合。实例化三种变体：FlowBP-Sparse（稀疏欧拉重建）、FlowBP-Bridge（受控桥耦合）、FlowBP-Lagrange（高阶蛙跳求积），均通过活跃集大小约束内存，且梯度链限制至多一个雅可比因子。

Result: 在SD3.5-M、FLUX.1-dev、FLUX.2-Klein-base三个模型上，基于偏好、质量和组合指标的评估中，三种变体在大多数指标上优于直接梯度基线方法。

Conclusion: FlowBP框架有效解决了直接奖励反向传播的核心工程瓶颈，通过代理轨迹设计实现了内存可控、梯度稳定的优化，为大规模文本到图像模型的人类偏好对齐提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Aligning text-to-image flow matching models with human preferences via direct reward backpropagation is sample-efficient but hampered by two well-known pathologies: activations cannot be stored across the full sampling trajectory at modern model scale, and chained Jacobian products across steps inflate the reward gradient as it travels back to early indices. Connector-based methods, such as LeapAlign, address these issues by replacing the full backward trajectory with a short pinned path, highlighting a useful decoupling between sampling and optimization. However, the quality of the resulting gradient depends on how accurately this short path approximates the full rollout, especially over long intervals. We propose FlowBP, a unified surrogate-trajectory framework that treats the backward trajectory itself as the design object. FlowBP keeps a no-gradient cached rollout for sampling, then builds a lightweight backward surrogate from cached and selectively re-forwarded velocities. This view separates four choices: the reward-model input, active set, integration weights, and bridge coupling, and recovers prior direct-gradient methods as particular settings. Within this framework, we instantiate three variants: FlowBP-Sparse uses sparse Euler reconstruction, FlowBP-Bridge adds controlled bridge coupling, and FlowBP-Lagrange raises the order of leap quadrature. All three bound memory by the active-set size and limit gradient chaining to at most one Jacobian factor. Across SD3.5-M, FLUX.1-dev, and FLUX.2-Klein-base on preference, quality, and compositional metrics, the three variants improve over direct-gradient baselines on most metrics.

</details>


### [387] [Unifying Local Communications and Local Updates for LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11081)
*Pietro Cagnasso,Eugene Belilovsky,Edouard Oyallon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GASLoC是一种新型去中心化预训练算法，通过泛化通信加速到"外部优化器"，实现兼容自适应优化器、支持本地优化步长和稀疏随机对等通信的高效训练框架，在多个LLM训练任务中优于现有去中心化算法，并在异构带宽场景下显著超越DiLoCo。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM预训练的同步All-Reduce操作在带宽或工作节点速度异构时成为瓶颈，需要一种通信高效的去中心化训练方法，既能减少通信频率又能适应异构环境。

Method: GASLoC将通信加速概念泛化到"外部优化器"，提出基于八卦（gossip）的训练框架，兼容自适应优化器（如Adam），支持本地优化器步长，并利用稀疏随机化对等通信。

Result: 在标准LLM训练任务中，GASLoC在单步通信设置下优于现有去中心化算法；在多步本地更新场景下性能与DiLoCo相当；在异构带宽环境中显著优于DiLoCo。

Conclusion: GASLoC提供了一种实用的去中心化预训练范式，在保持通信效率的同时，能够有效应对带宽异构性，为大规模LLM分布式训练提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Communication-efficient pre-training of LLMs is increasingly important as training draws on compute distributed across clusters, data centers, and lower-bandwidth links. Many practical methods reduce communication frequency but still rely on synchronous All-Reduce operations that maintain identical model states and tie progress to global collectives. This can become a bottleneck when bandwidth or worker speed is heterogeneous. We introduce GASLoC, a novel decentralized pre-training algorithm that generalizes the notion of communication acceleration to the recently popular "outer optimizer" to allow a practical gossip-based training framework that is compatible with adaptive optimizers, allows for local optimizer steps, and can utilize sparse randomized peer communication. Empirically, on a number of standard LLM training tasks, we demonstrate that GASLoC outperforms state-of-the-art decentralized algorithms in single step per communication setting for a number of topologies and, unlike existing decentralized methods in the LLM setting, it allows to obtain performance competitive with DiLoCo when utilizing multiple local steps. In the heterogeneous bandwidth setting we demonstrate the advantage of GASLoC showing that it can significantly outperform DiLoCo.

</details>


### [388] [Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11087)
*Zhiyuan Zhou,Andy Peng,Charles Xu,Qiyang Li,Tobias Springenberg,Kevin Frans,Sergey Levine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QGF（Q引导流）算法，通过在测试时利用价值函数梯度引导预训练的流策略生成高价值动作，无需额外的策略训练，实现了与训练时RL算法竞争力相当的性能，同时避免了对扩散/流模型进行RL训练的稳定性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型和流模型等表达性连续控制策略在监督模仿学习中表现优异，但将它们整合到强化学习（RL）管道中进行策略改进时面临困难，通常需要专门训练目标或通过去噪过程反向传播，导致稳定性问题和扩展性受限。

Method: QGF首先预训练一个参考流策略（使用标准行为克隆目标）和一个价值函数评论家；然后在测试时，使用价值梯度引导参考策略生成更高价值的动作，完全在测试时完成策略优化，无需额外的策略学习。

Result: 在单任务和目标条件离线RL基准测试中，QGF在具有高维动作空间的任务上优于以往的测试时RL方法；与最先进的训练时算法相比具有竞争力，且运行成本更低；随着模型规模扩展表现出良好的可扩展性。

Conclusion: QGF提供了一种实用且有效的替代RL算法，通过避免演员-评论家训练的不稳定性，在测试时利用表达性策略进行策略优化，兼顾了性能与效率。

Abstract: Expressive continuous control policies, such as diffusion and flow models, form the backbone of recent advances in scaling imitation learning for simulated and real robot control. While they are known to scale stably in the supervised imitation learning setting, incorporating them into reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for policy improvement has proven more difficult. It often requires specialized training objectives or backpropagating through denoising processes, which cause well-known issues with stability and affect scalability. In this paper we study the question of whether simple policy improvement schemes at test time alone, leaving stable supervised policy training intact, can be a competitive alternative which sidesteps these issues. To this end, we propose QGF (Q-Guided Flow), an RL algorithm that performs policy optimization entirely at test time. QGF works by pre-training both a reference flow policy (via a standard behavioral cloning objective) and a value function critic and, at test time, using the value gradient to guide the reference policy to generate higher-value actions without any additional policy learning. Empirically, QGF outperforms prior test-time RL methods on single-task and goal-conditioned offline RL benchmarks with high-dimensional action spaces, and is competitive with state-of-the-art training-time algorithms while being much cheaper to run. Moreover, it exhibits favorable scaling with model size by avoiding the instability of actor-critic training, offering a practical and effective alternative RL algorithm with expressive policies.

</details>


### [389] [Limitations of Learning Tanh Neural Networks with Finite Precision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11104)
*Philipp Grohs,Matěj Trödler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在有限精度计算和L^p精度保证下，使用点评估学习tanh神经网络的局限性。通过构建基于迭代tanh激活的尖锐局部化bump函数，证明在有限精度设置下，除非采样预算随网络参数和架构规模指数增长，否则任何基于m个样本的自适应随机算法在L^p范数下的收敛速率不能超过蒙特卡洛速率O(m^{-1/p})。该结果揭示了有限精度对包含局部化bump函数类别可学习性的根本限制，将此前ReLU网络的结果扩展至tanh设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解有限精度计算对神经网络学习能力的根本限制，特别是对tanh激活函数网络在L^p精度下的可学习性边界。

Method: 通过迭代tanh激活函数构造尖锐局部化bump函数，分析有限精度下自适应随机算法的收敛速率下界。

Result: 在有限精度设置下，基于m个样本的自适应随机算法在L^p范数下的收敛速率不能超过蒙特卡洛速率O(m^{-1/p})，除非采样预算随网络参数和架构规模指数增长。

Conclusion: 有限精度对包含局部化bump函数的神经网络类别的可学习性存在根本性限制，该结论从ReLU网络推广至tanh网络。

Abstract: We investigate limitations of learning $\tanh$ neural networks from point evaluations under finite-precision computations and $L^p$ accuracy guarantees, building on Berner, Grohs, and Voigtländer (2023). Our approach is based on a novel construction of sharply localized bump functions via iterated $\tanh$ activations. Using this mechanism, we show that, in a finite-precision setting, no adaptive randomized algorithm based on $m$ samples can achieve a convergence rate higher than the Monte Carlo rate $O(m^{-1/p})$ in the $L^p$ norm, unless the sampling budget grows exponentially with the size of the network parameters and architecture. The results reveal fundamental limitations imposed by finite precision on the learnability of classes containing localized bump functions, extending previous results for ReLU networks to the $\tanh$ setting.

</details>


### [390] [Data-Driven Dynamic Assortment in Online Platforms: Learning about Two Sides](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11118)
*Rahul Roy,Nur Sunar,Jayashankar M. Swaminathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了双边服务平台上的动态分类问题，其中平台对顾客和卖家的选择模型参数均未知。作者提出了一种数据驱动算法，能够同时学习双方的选择参数并优化平台目标，证明了算法的遗憾值随时间呈多对数增长，并推导了匹配的下界，验证了算法的速率最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动态分类研究大多假设只有一方（顾客或卖家）的选择参数未知，而实际双边平台中双方的选择偏好均不确定。本文首次在双边选择参数均未知的场景下研究动态分类问题，填补了这一理论空白。

Method: 建立离散时间模型：每期顾客到达→平台选择卖家分类→顾客按MNL模型选择至多一个卖家→固定周期后卖家按MNL模型选择至多一个顾客。设计数据驱动算法同时学习顾客和卖家的MNL选择参数，并通过遗憾值分析评估性能，与知晓全部参数和顾客到达的全知基准进行比较。

Result: 算法的最坏情况遗憾值随时间呈多对数增长，并且推导了匹配的下界，证明了该算法的速率最优性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的算法在双方选择参数均未知的双边平台动态分类问题中实现了最优的遗憾值收敛速率，为该类平台的实际运营提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: We study a dynamic assortment problem on a two-sided service platform with incomplete information and heterogeneous customers in a discrete-time setting. In each period, a customer arrives seeking service, and the platform chooses an assortment of sellers to display. The customer then proposes a transaction to at most one seller in the assortment according to a multinomial logit choice model. After a fixed number of periods, sellers review the proposals they have received and each chooses at most one customer according to another multinomial logit choice model, after which the cycle repeats. A key challenge is that the platform does not know the choice-model parameters of either customers or sellers in advance. To our knowledge, this is the first study of a dynamic assortment problem in which both sides' choice parameters are unknown. We develop a data-driven algorithm that learns these parameters while optimizing the platform's objective over time. We evaluate performance using regret, which measures revenue loss relative to a clairvoyant benchmark that knows all parameters and customer arrivals in advance. We show that the algorithm's worst-case regret grows polylogarithmically over time, and we derive a matching lower bound, establishing its rate optimality.

</details>


### [391] [TRACE: A Unified Rollout Budget Allocation Framework for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11119)
*Heming Zou,Qi Wang,Yun Qu,Yuhang Jiang,Lizhou Cai,Yixiu Mao,Ru Peng,Xin Xu,Weijie Liu,Kai Yang,Saiyong Yang,Xiangyang Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE框架，通过将Multi-turn RL中的rollout扩展到树形结构（按ReAct风格的turn划分语义节点），在固定采样预算下智能分配资源到prompt根节点和中间前缀节点，以增强奖励对比度，提升策略更新信号。在agentic benchmark上取得竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法面临奖励对比度不足的问题：过于简单或复杂的prompt产生低方差反馈，且outcome-only奖励在multi-turn rollout中对每步决策赋予相同的终端评估。过去方法仅在prompt级别分配资源，忽视了同一rollout内不同turn的前缀级别信息量差异。

Method: 将每个ReAct风格（thought-action-observation）的turn建模为语义不同的节点，使rollout从prompt根节点扩展到turn级别前缀节点，形成树结构。TRACE通过一个可泛化的预测器，基于前缀历史估计条件成功概率，从而将预算分配给最可能产生混合终端奖励的根节点和中间前缀节点。

Result: 在典型agentic benchmark上取得竞争性表现和效率提升，例如Qwen3-14B在Multi-Hop QA上平均准确率提升2.8个点，且采样成本相同。

Conclusion: TRACE通过树形rollout分配有效增强了奖励对比度，在不增加采样预算的情况下提升了策略更新信号，为multi-turn agentic RL提供了更高效的训练范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a promising approach for enhancing reasoning and agentic behavior in large language models. However, rollout-intensive policy optimization is often limited by insufficient reward contrast, arising when overly simple or complex prompts generate low-variance feedback and when outcome-only rewards assign the same terminal assessment to every decision in a multi-turn rollout. Past efforts have focused on allocating available rollout resources to promising prompts, yet they only leverage sample informativeness at the prompt level and neglect variation in prefix-level informativeness across turns within the same rollout. This work targets multi-turn agentic RL by modeling each ReAct-style thought-action-observation turn as a semantically distinct node, allowing budget allocation to extend from prompt roots to turn-level prefixes with further continuations, which naturally forms tree-structured rollouts. We introduce Tree Rollout Allocation for Contrastive Exploration (TRACE), a unified rollout allocation framework that enhances reward contrast within a fixed sampling budget. Technically, TRACE allocates rollout budget to both prompt roots and intermediate prefixes that are most likely to yield mixed terminal rewards. A shared generalizable predictor estimates conditional success probability at these anchors from prefix histories to guide this allocation. The resulting adaptive tree structure enriches outcome-only feedback and amplifies the policy-update signal. Empirically, TRACE achieves competitive performance and efficiency gains on typical agentic benchmarks, e.g., improving Qwen3-14B Multi-Hop QA average accuracy by 2.8 points over competitive baselines at equal sampling cost.

</details>


### [392] [Overcoming Rank Collapse in Feedback Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11123)
*Gauthier Boeshertz,Razvan Pascanu,Claudia Clopath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了反馈对齐（FA）在深层架构中扩展性差的原因，发现FA的误差信号有效秩显著低于BP，限制了参数空间的探索。通过引入Muon优化器和隐藏活动归一化来提高信号的有效维度，在CIFAR100+ResNet-18上准确率提升9个百分点，表明提升更新几何维度是扩展BP替代方案的有效途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BP因其需要前向权重转置作为反馈权重而被认为生物不合理，FA使用固定随机反馈权重可规避此问题，但在深层架构中扩展性差，需探究其根本原因并寻找改进方法。

Method: 首先通过有效秩（effective rank）对比BP和FA在CIFAR10上的误差信号差异；然后提出两种提升FA有效维度的方法：Muon优化器（正交化权重更新）和隐藏活动归一化（促进激活正交性）。

Result: FA误差信号的有效秩显著低于BP，被约束在低维子空间中。所提两种方法在深层架构上一致提升FA性能，在CIFAR100+ResNet-18上准确率提升9个百分点。

Conclusion: 低维梯度动力学是FA无法扩展的关键障碍，诱导更高维度的更新几何是扩展BP替代方案的有前景方向。

Abstract: Backpropagation (BP) is widely viewed as biologically implausible, in part because it requires feedback weights to be the transpose of forward weights for error propagation. Interestingly, when training a network with fixed random feedback weights to circumvent this issue, learning aligns the forward weights with the feedback weights, leading the backpropagated error signal to become an approximation of the standard gradient used by BP. This process, called Feedback Alignment (FA), occurs in MLPs and very shallow CNNs but does not scale well to deeper architectures. In this work, we first investigated differences between BP and FA models, trained on CIFAR10, specifically focusing on the effective rank of the signal. We found that the FA error has a considerably lower rank and hence is constrained to a lower-dimensional subspace compared to BP, limiting exploration of the parameter space. Motivated by this observation, we evaluated two mechanisms for increasing the effective dimensionality of FA: Muon, an optimiser that orthogonalises weight updates; and hidden activity normalisation, which promotes activation orthogonality. Across larger architectures and benchmarks, we find that these methods consistently improve over FA baselines, for example, on CIFAR100 with a Resnet-18, accuracy increases by 9 percentage points. Our results identify low-dimensional gradient dynamics as a key obstacle to scaling FA and suggest that inducing higher-dimensional update geometry is a promising route toward scaling alternatives to backpropagation.

</details>


### [393] [Robust Regression of General ReLUs with Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11130)
*Ilias Diakonikolas,Daniel M. Kane,Mingchen Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在高斯分布下使用平方损失函数对一般ReLU进行不可知学习的交互式学习问题，提出了首个计算高效的算法，仅需d polylog(1/ε)+Õ(min{1/p, 1/ε})个黑箱标签查询即可达到O(opt)+ε的误差，并证明了该查询复杂度在定性上是近乎最优的，同时建立了查询访问对于改善被动学习标签复杂度的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在交互式学习（主动学习）设定下，如何利用查询访问来降低学习一般ReLU函数所需的标签复杂度，弥补被动学习中标签效率低下的问题。

Method: 提出了一种计算高效的交互式学习算法，利用黑箱标签查询（black-box label queries），在高斯分布下对一般ReLU进行不可知学习，算法在查询复杂度上达到了d polylog(1/ε)+Õ(min{1/p, 1/ε})。

Result: 实现了O(opt)+ε的误差，查询复杂度在定性上近乎最优，并证明了主动学习至少需要Ω̃(d/ε)个标签，除非抽取超多项式数量的未标记样本。

Conclusion: 查询访问（交互式学习）在本质上对改善被动学习的标签复杂度是必要的，且所提算法的查询复杂度界在定性意义上是最优的。

Abstract: We study the task of agnostically learning general (as opposed to homogeneous) ReLUs under the Gaussian distribution with respect to the squared loss. In the passive learning setting, recent work gave a computationally efficient algorithm that uses $poly(d,1/ε)$ labeled examples and outputs a hypothesis with error $O(opt)+ε$, where $opt$ is the squared loss of the best fit ReLU. Here we focus on the interactive setting, where the learner has some form of query access to the labels of unlabeled examples. Our main result is the first computationally efficient learner that uses $d polylog(1/ε)+\tilde{O}(\min\{1/p, 1/ε\})$ black-box label queries, where $p$ is the bias of the target function, and achieves error $O(opt)+ε$. We complement our algorithmic result by showing that its query complexity bound is qualitatively near-optimal, even ignoring computational constraints. Finally, we establish that query access is essentially necessary to improve on the label complexity of passive learning. Specifically, for pool-based active learning, any active learner requires $\tildeΩ(d/ε)$ labels, unless it draws a super-polynomial number of unlabeled examples.

</details>


### [394] [First-Order Trajectory Matching: Fast Ensemble Predictions of Chaotic, Turbulent, Stochastic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11138)
*Shreya Jha,Timo Schorlepp,Nicholas Geissler,Jules Berman,Benjamin Peherstorfer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一阶轨迹匹配（FTM），一种从随机系统轨迹中学习概率质量一阶局部传输的代理建模方法，无需估计漂移、扩散或得分，即可直接学习概率流速度，捕捉通量、环流和势垒穿越流等轨迹量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代理建模方法难以同时准确预测系综平均值和捕获类似于轨迹的电流量（如通量、环流和势垒穿越流），且通常需要估计漂移、扩散或得分，存在数值不稳定性。

Method: 通过匹配轨迹的对称一阶运动来学习概率流速度；直接根据轨迹学习，避免漂移、扩散和得分估计；采用单步免模拟的FTM损失，并通过稳定性分析揭示了离散化误差与采样方差之间的平衡关系。

Result: 在随机动力系统和PDE示例上，FTM能以低成本、确定性滚动的方式提供轨迹感知的系综预测，有效捕捉通量、环流和势垒穿越流等轨迹量。

Conclusion: FTM是一种稳定且高效的代理建模方法，能够在平衡时间分辨率与样本量的条件下实现轨迹感知的系综预测，为随机系统动力学建模提供了新途径。

Abstract: We introduce First-Order Trajectory Matching (FTM), a surrogate-modeling method that learns the first-order local transport of probability mass from trajectories of stochastic systems. By matching the symmetric first-order motion of trajectories, FTM learns the probability current velocity, whose flow preserves time marginals to match ensemble averages, while also capturing current-like trajectory quantities such as fluxes, circulations, and barrier-crossing currents. FTM learns the current velocity directly from trajectories, avoiding drift, diffusion, and score estimation. Our stability analysis separates discretization error from sampling variance and shows that the one-step simulation-free FTM loss is stable when temporal resolution and sample size are properly balanced. Across stochastic dynamical systems and PDE examples, we empirically demonstrate that FTM provides trajectory-aware ensemble predictions at low, deterministic-rollout cost.

</details>


### [395] [OncoTraj: a public benchmark for longitudinal resistance prediction in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer on osimertinib](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11144)
*Abhijoy Sarkar,Aarchi Singh Thakur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OncoTraj是一个公开基准，包含813名接受一线奥希替尼治疗的EGFR突变NSCLC患者数据，定义了三个锁定任务（12个月进展二元分类、进展时间回归、耐药机制六分类），但基于单时间点组织NGS特征的模型均未超越随机水平，表明当前瓶颈在于输入模态（单次组织NGS而非系列ctDNA），为v2版本提出了具体设计需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EGFR突变NSCLC对一线奥希替尼的耐药是治疗压力下可预测克隆演化的典型范例，但长期以来缺乏用于训练或评估计算模型的公开基准，阻碍了该领域计算方法的可重复性发展和公平比较。
