Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. OPRD also trains 1.44x faster and uses 54% less memory than top-k OPD. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.

</details>


### [469] [Principles and Practice of Deep Representation Learning: or a Mathematical Theory of Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06624)
*Sam Buchanan,Druv Pai,Peng Wang,Yi Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本书旨在通过表征学习的视角揭开大型深度神经网络的黑箱，阐述现代神经网络架构的设计原理（基于优化和信息论），并应用这些原理设计高效、可解释、可控的新型模型，同时探讨深度学习的未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度神经网络作为"黑箱"模型难以理解，导致可解释性、可靠性和可控性方面的困难，也引发了过度炒作和恐惧，因此亟需打开黑箱、理解其内部机制。

Method: 通过表征学习的视角，运用优化理论与信息论阐述神经网络架构的设计原理，将架构开发过程简化为本科水平的线性代数和微积分问题，并应用这些原理设计新的方法和模型。

Result: 获得了高效、可解释、可控且性能不亚于甚至优于黑箱模型的新方法和新模型。

Conclusion: 表征学习是深度学习的核心因素，理解其原理能够设计出既强大又可解释的模型，为深度学习的未来发展指明方向。

Abstract: In the current era of deep learning and especially generative models, there is significant investment in training very large deep neural networks. Thus far, such models have been "black boxes" that are difficult to understand in the sense that they have opaque internal mechanisms, leading to difficulties in interpretability, reliability, and control. Naturally, this lack of understanding has led to both hype and fear.
  This book is an attempt to "open the black box" and understand the mechanisms of large deep networks, through the perspective of representation learning, which is a major factor - arguably the single most important one - in the empirical power of deep learning models. A brief outline of this book is as follows. Chapter 1 will summarize the threads that underlie the whole text. Chapters 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 will explain the design principles of modern neural network architectures through optimization and information theory, reducing the process of architecture development (long having been described as a sort of "alchemy") to undergraduate-level linear algebra and calculus exercises once the underlying principles are introduced. Chapters 7 and 8 will discuss applications of these principles to solve problems in more paradigmatic ways, obtaining new methods and models which are efficient, interpretable, and controllable by design, and yet no less - sometimes even more - powerful than the black-box models they resemble. Chapter 9 will discuss potential future directions for deep learning, the role of representation learning, as well as some open problems.

</details>


### [470] [RECAP: Regression Evaluation for Continual Adaptation of Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06698)
*Harsh Deshpande,Kushal Chawla,Sangwoo Cho,William Campbell,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RECAP是一个衡量在严格的前瞻性适应-测试协议下，提示优化方法面对演变约束时持续学习现象的基准。实验发现现有方法在性能上无显著提升，不适合前瞻性部署场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中的智能体系统经常面临动态变化的约束（如策略更新、合规阈值变更），但现有基准仅考虑静态约束或具有评估反馈的反应式协议，缺乏对前瞻性适应场景的评估。

Method: 提出RECAP基准，采用严格的前瞻性适应-测试协议：提示优化方法仅接收约束规范，必须在未见任何测试数据的情况下泛化。评估六种方法在四种LLM和三种演变约束调度上的表现。

Result: 现有方法在性能上无显著提升，即使付出了更高延迟的代价。这些为离线或反应式场景设计的方法无法适应前瞻性范式。

Conclusion: 需要设计前瞻性提示适应方法，使模型在部署中面对不断演变的需求时保持鲁棒性。

Abstract: Production agentic systems routinely face evolving constraints and must comply from the very next interaction. Scenarios like a tool-call notification changing a compliance threshold or a policy update adding disclosure requirements fit this criteria, having close to no room for errors in production. This proactive adaptation setting is common in deployment, but absent from current benchmarks, which assume either static constraint sets or reactive protocols with evaluation feedback. We introduce RECAP, a benchmark that measures continual-learning phenomena (forgetting, regression, forward transfer) at the constraint level under a strictly proactive adapt-then-test protocol: prompt optimization methods receive only the constraint specification and must generalize before seeing any test data. Evaluating six methods across four LLMs and three schedules with evolving constraints, we find that these methods show no significant improvement in performance, even after incurring a higher latency. These methods, designed for offline or reactive settings, are inadequate for the proactive paradigm. Our work emphasizes the growing need for designing proactive prompt adaptation methods, where the models must remain robust to evolving needs in deployment.

</details>


### [471] [TorchKM: A GPU-Oriented Library for Kernel Learning and Model Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06742)
*Yikai Zhang,Gaoxiang Jia,Jie Ding,Boxiang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TorchKM是一个基于GPU加速的开源核机器库，支持SVM、核逻辑回归和核分位数回归，提供scikit-learn风格API，通过智能复用矩阵运算加速训练和模型选择流程，在保持竞争力的预测性能下实现显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为核机器提供高效、可编程的GPU加速实现，弥补现有工具在GPU利用率和开发便利性方面的不足，使其能够集成到AI驱动的工作流中作为核学习组件。

Method: 设计scikit-learn风格API，利用GPU友好的线性代数运算，通过智能复用矩阵运算加速完整训练和模型选择流程。

Result: 在保持竞争力的预测性能下，相比标准基线实现了显著的加速。

Conclusion: TorchKM是一个高效、可编程的核机器库，可作为AI工作流中的核学习组件，代码和文档已开源并提供PyPI安装方式。

Abstract: TorchKM is an open-source library for kernel machines, including support vector machines, kernel logistic regression, and kernel quantile regression, with GPU acceleration. The library features a scikit-learn-style API and is designed to exploit GPU-friendly linear algebra, accelerating the full training and model-selection pipeline through intelligent reuse of matrix operations. Benchmarks show competitive predictive performance with substantial speedups over standard baselines. The efficiency and programmable design also make TorchKM a kernel-learning component for AI-driven workflows. Code and documentation are available at https://github.com/YikaiZhang95/torchkm, and the package can be easily installed via PyPI.

</details>


### [472] [Learn to Match: Two-Sided Matching with Temporally Extended Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06744)
*Haijing Zong,Yancheng Liang,Boyang Zhou,Natasha Jaques*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Learn2Match，一个基于多智能体强化学习的动态双边匹配市场基准框架，将匹配过程建模为部分可观测马尔可夫博弈，支持面试、匹配和解约等时序决策。实验发现独立PPO在累积社会福利和后悔方面优于bandit基线，但信息摩擦损失更高，表明端到端MARL仍缺乏匹配bandit方法的协调探索结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双边匹配模型通常将匹配过程简化为关于固定偏好的即时亚高斯反馈，忽略了通过面试、重复互动和学习等方式逐步揭示的时序信息，这些信息会影响未来的匹配决策，因此需要一个能够捕捉时序扩展反馈的框架。

Method: 将动态双边匹配建模为部分可观测马尔可夫博弈（POMG），包含昂贵的匹配前筛选、有噪声的匹配后观测、演化的潜在特征向量以及内生的匹配延续或解散。基于此框架构建Learn2Bench多智能体强化学习基准，支持分散决策：面试谁、匹配谁、何时解散匹配。

Result: 独立PPO在累积社会福利和累积后悔方面优于bandit风格的CA-ETC基线；但PPO的信息摩擦损失更高，表明其尚未提供匹配bandit方法的协调探索结构。

Conclusion: Learn2Match可作为下一代匹配市场算法的基准，这些算法需要兼具RL的自适应性、bandit算法的统计纪律性以及稳定匹配机制的结构感知能力。

Abstract: Two-sided matching markets often involve information that unfolds over time through interviews, repeated interaction, learning, and separation. Existing matching models typically reduce this process to immediate sub-Gaussian feedback about fixed preferences, missing settings where payoff-relevant information is revealed gradually and changes future matching decisions. We introduce a framework with temporally extended feedback, that formulates two-sided matching as a partially observable Markov game with costly pre-match screening, noisy post-match observations, evolving latent profiles, and endogenous continuation or dissolution. We instantiate this framework in Learn2Match, a multi-agent reinforcement-learning benchmark for dynamic matching markets. Learn2Match supports decentralized decision making over whom to interview, whom to match with, and when to dissolve a match, while evaluating policies using regret, social welfare, and an information-friction loss that measures the welfare gap caused by incomplete revelation of latent preferences. We find that independent PPO achieves higher cumulative social welfare and lower cumulative regret than the bandit-style CA-ETC baseline under temporally extended feedback, demonstrating the promise of MARL for dynamic matching markets. However, PPO still incurs higher information-friction loss, revealing that end-to-end MARL does not yet provide the coordinated exploration structure of matching-bandit methods. These results position Learn2Match as a benchmark for developing the next generation of matching-market algorithms: methods that are adaptive like RL agents, statistically disciplined like bandit algorithms, and structurally aware like stable-matching mechanisms. Please refer to https://sites.google.com/view/learn-to-match/home for the official website and the code link.

</details>


### [473] [Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining: Improved Regularization and Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06888)
*Zhiwei Xu,Shihao Wu,Hanseul Cho,Wei Hu,Yixin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了数据受限下的语言模型预训练，提出掩码输入正则化（MIR）提升性能，并推出新的缩放定律SoftQ以更准确建模重复数据场景下的模型规模与数据量交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着训练计算增长快于自然语言数据供给，预训练将进入数据受限、计算充裕的多次遍历有限数据集阶段，需要研究该场景下的正则化与缩放规律。

Method: 提出MIR（掩码输入正则化），即在自回归预训练中加入对随机掩码输入的辅助下一个词预测损失；提出SoftQ缩放定律，耦合模型规模与数据量捕捉重复数据下的交互效应。

Result: MIR在72M至1.4B参数模型上优于仅用强权重衰减的自回归模型，1.4B时下游任务有提升；SoftQ比Chinchilla等经典缩放定律更好地拟合数据受限实验，估算MIR收益等价于约1.3倍独有训练数据。

Conclusion: MIR可作为数据受限预训练的有效正则化手段，SoftQ为数据受限场景提供了更准确的缩放建模工具，代码已开源。

Abstract: Classical scaling laws for language model pretraining balance model size against training dataset size under a fixed compute budget, assuming abundant data and a single pass over the corpus. As training compute grows faster than the supply of natural language data, pretraining is likely to enter a data-constrained, compute-rich regime where models train for multiple epochs over a finite dataset. We study data-constrained pretraining along two axes, regularization and scaling. For regularization, we study masked-input regularization (MIR), an auxiliary next-token prediction loss on randomly masked inputs. MIR tests whether the random masking central to diffusion language models can benefit autoregressive pretraining without architectural changes or inference overhead. Across 72M to 1.4B parameter models, we find that MIR added on top of strong weight decay improves validation loss over autoregressive strong-weight-decay-only models, with downstream gains at 1.4B. For scaling, we propose SoftQ, a scaling law that couples model size and data size to capture their interaction under repeated data. Classical alternatives such as the Chinchilla law use an additive form that decouples these terms, making them misspecified in the data-constrained regime. We find that SoftQ fits data-constrained experiments substantially better than these alternatives, and estimates MIR's gains as equivalent to roughly 1.3 times as much unique training data. We release our code at https://github.com/yixinw-lab/dc_pretrain.

</details>


### [474] [Residual-Controlled Multiplier Learning for Stochastic Constrained Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07088)
*Kang Liu,Jianchen Hu,Ziyu Qu,Edward Hengzhou Yan,Lun Yang,Meng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对随机约束决策中原始-对偶方法在高噪声小批量反馈下乘子更新不稳定的问题，提出残差控制乘子学习（RCML），将乘子更新重构为投影压力反馈机制，通过分解投影乘子为有效压力信号和压力记忆残差，结合模块化随机稳定组件，实现有限增益收敛和KKT残差解释，在优化、分配和公平排名任务中提升了可行性控制和乘子稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准原始-对偶方法在随机小批量反馈下，其乘子更新会累积小批量梯度和约束估计的噪声，导致乘子记忆不稳定，难以鲁棒地更新乘子。

Method: 提出残差控制乘子学习（RCML），将乘子更新重构为投影压力反馈机制：(1) 将投影乘子分解为用于原始下降的有效压力信号和用于有限增益乘子跟踪的压力记忆残差；(2) 在此残差-积分骨干上增加模块化随机稳定组件以处理异构噪声观测。

Result: 建立了凸-仿射骨干的有限增益收敛性，推导了小批量反馈下的随机残差界，证明了非凸问题正则KKT点附近残差反馈律具有局部KKT残差解释。实验表明RCML在优化、分配和公平排名任务中改善了可行性控制和乘子稳定性，同时保持了有竞争力的目标性能。

Conclusion: RCML通过残差控制机制有效解决了随机约束优化中乘子更新不稳定的问题，在理论和实验上均验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Stochastic constrained decision-making requires optimizing performance objectives while enforcing statistical requirements such as safety or fairness. However, standard primal--dual methods struggle to update multipliers robustly under stochastic mini-batch feedback, as the noise of mini-batch gradients and constraint estimates can be directly accumulated into the multiplier memory. To address this issue, we propose Residual-Controlled Multiplier Learning (RCML), which reformulates multiplier updating as projected-pressure feedback. The central idea is to decompose the projected multiplier into an effective pressure signal for primal descent and a pressure-memory residual for finite-gain multiplier tracking. To handle heterogeneous and noisy observations, we further augment this residual-integral backbone with modular stochastic stabilization components. For the convex-affine backbone, we establish finite-gain convergence, derive a stochastic residual bound under mini-batch feedback, and show that the residual feedback law admits a local KKT-residual interpretation near regular KKT points of nonconvex problems. Experiments across optimization, allocation, and fair-ranking tasks show that RCML improves feasibility control and multiplier stability while maintaining competitive objective performance. Code is released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RCML-3114/.

</details>


### [475] [Explaining Unsupervised Disease Staging in Huntington's Disease: Insights into Model Representations and Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07135)
*Lubna Mahmoud Abu Zohair,Hind Zantout*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在无监督机器学习疾病分期框架中引入可解释性分析，通过降维投影、显著性图和SHAP等方法，验证了Enroll-HD数据集上亨廷顿病潜在分期的临床意义，揭示了从早期认知-运动障碍到严重功能依赖的进展模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督机器学习虽能从纵向数据中发现疾病进展轨迹和潜在阶段，但其可解释性有限，限制了临床信任和转化应用。

Method: 在已有的ML疾病分期框架上应用可解释性分析：1) 将学习到的表征投影到低维空间评估聚类与临床指标的对齐程度；2) 使用显著性图识别对嵌入贡献最大的临床特征；3) 训练替代分类器并应用SHAP量化特征对聚类分配的重要性及阶段转换的驱动因素。

Result: 可解释性分析表明学习到的嵌入捕捉了有临床意义的疾病结构，与运动、功能严重程度评分一致，呈现渐进恶化趋势；SHAP揭示了从早期认知-运动障碍到严重功能依赖的分层分期，同时显示出阶段内变异性。

Conclusion: 通过可解释性分析验证了无监督学习发现的分期与已知临床进展模式一致，增强了模型的可信度，有助于推动其临床转化应用。

Abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects motor, cognitive, and behavioral functions, where accurate characterization of disease progression remains essential to improve patient outcome and quality of life. Unsupervised machine learning (ML) approaches have demonstrated the ability to uncover disease progression trajectories and meaningful latent stages from longitudinal data; however, their limited interpretability restricts clinical trust and translation. We extend a previously proposed ML-based disease staging framework by applying an explainability analysis to the extracted feature representations and discovered disease stages. Applied to the Enroll-HD dataset, we first project the learned representations into a lower-dimensional space to intuitively assess whether the resulting clusters align with the progression of established clinical measures. We then use saliency maps to identify the clinical features that most strongly contribute to the learned embeddings over time. Finally, we train a surrogate classifier and apply SHAP to quantify feature importance for cluster assignments and to analyze which clinical variables drive transitions between disease stages. The explainability analysis indicates that the learned embeddings capture clinically meaningful disease structure, aligning with established motor and functional severity scores and exhibiting progressive deterioration across clusters. Within this analysis, SHAP reveals a stratification of disease stages, ranging from early cognitive-motor impairment to severe functional dependency, consistent with known clinical progression patterns, while also highlighting intra-stage variability.

</details>


### [476] [From Human Guidance to Autonomy: Agent Skill System for End-to-End LLM Deployment on Spatial NPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07586)
*Jiajie Li,Erwei Wang,Zhiru Zhang,Samuel Bayliss*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段方法论，在AMD XDNA 2 NPU上实现从人工引导到智能体自主的LLM端到端部署。第一阶段通过人类引导的智能体辅助开发Llama-3.2-1B参考部署，相比手动优化基线实现了2.2倍（prefill）和4.0倍（decode）加速；第二阶段将经验蒸馏为包含八个阶段的智能体技能系统，成功自主部署了8个额外的仅解码器LLM（0.5-4小时/个，几乎无需人工干预），其中3个模型的性能达到或超过参考部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限的空间NPU上高效端到端部署LLM目前仍高度依赖人工，现有研究多聚焦于单核优化而非完整部署流程，缺乏自动化的端到端解决方案。

Method: 两阶段方法论：第一阶段，人类引导的智能体辅助开发参考部署，记录优化轨迹和经验文档；第二阶段，将文档蒸馏为包含八个阶段的智能体技能系统，严格强制执行数值正确性，实现自主部署。

Result: 参考部署实现2.2倍（prefill）和4.0倍（decode）加速；8个额外LLM实现自主端到端部署（0.5-4小时/个），其中3个性能达到或超过参考部署；据作者所知，这些模型首次通过开源软件栈部署在AMD NPU上。

Conclusion: 提出的智能体技能系统能够实现从人工到自主的LLM NPU部署，具有功能泛化能力，且无需特定模型的人工工程优化即可获得有竞争力的性能。

Abstract: Spatial neural processing units (NPUs) provide an energy-efficient platform for edge LLM inference, but efficiently deploying an LLM end-to-end on such hardware remains labor-intensive. Although AI coding agents have begun to lower this cost, existing studies have largely focused on single-kernel optimization rather than end-to-end LLM deployment on resource-constrained spatial NPUs.
  We present a two-stage methodology, instantiated on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU, that progresses from human-guided development to agent autonomy. In the first stage, we develop a reference deployment of Llama-3.2-1B through human-guided agent assistance. The resulting implementation achieves a speedup of 2.2x on prefill and 4.0x on decode over the hand-optimized baseline, with the optimization trajectory and its lessons recorded as structured documentation throughout. In the second stage, we distill the documentation into an agent skill system consisting of eight phases, orchestrating the optimization and debugging skill sets, with numerical correctness strictly enforced at each phase.
  Using our agent skill system, we autonomously deploy eight additional decoder-only LLMs (Llama-3.2-3B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Qwen2.5-{0.5B, 1.5B, 3B}, Qwen3-{0.6B, 1.7B, 4B}) end-to-end on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU using the open-source compiler stack. To our knowledge, these models have not previously been deployed on AMD NPUs via any open-source software stack. Each deployment completes in 0.5-4 hours of agent wall time with almost no human guidance, and passes the numerical-correctness gates, demonstrating functional generalization to previously unencountered LLMs. Three of the eight match or exceed the sustained performance of our Llama-3.2-1B reference deployment, suggesting that the resulting implementations can be competitive without additional model-specific human engineering.

</details>


### [477] [SRT: Super-Resolution for Time Series via Disentangled Rectified Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07605)
*Jufang Duan,Shenglong Xiao,Yuren Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SRT框架，通过解纠缠整流流将低分辨率时间序列重建为高分辨率信号，SRT-large版本通过大规模预训练实现零样本超分辨率，在九个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高时间分辨率的时间序列数据对精确分析至关重要，但获取成本高、可行性低。现有图像超分辨率技术难以直接迁移到时间序列领域。

Method: 提出SRT框架：(1) 将输入分解为趋势和季节成分；(2) 使用隐式神经表示对齐目标分辨率；(3) 引入跨分辨率注意力机制生成高分辨率细节。SRT-large通过大规模预训练实现零样本超分辨率。

Result: 在九个公开数据集上，SRT和SRT-large在多种尺度因子下均优于现有方法，各组件有效性经实验验证。

Conclusion: SRT框架有效解决了时间序列超分辨率问题，分解-对齐-生成的三阶段设计以及跨分辨率注意力机制是关键创新，大规模预训练进一步提升了泛化能力。

Abstract: Fine-grained time series data with high temporal resolution is critical for accurate analytics across a wide range of applications. However, the acquisition of such data is often limited by cost and feasibility. This problem can be tackled by reconstructing high-resolution signals from low-resolution inputs based on specific priors, known as super-resolution. While extensively studied in computer vision, directly transferring image super-resolution techniques to time series is not trivial. To address this challenge at a fundamental level, we propose Super-Resolution for Time series (SRT), a novel framework that reconstructs temporal patterns lost in low-resolution inputs via disentangled rectified flow. SRT decomposes the input into trend and seasonal components, aligns them to the target resolution using an implicit neural representation, and leverages a novel cross-resolution attention mechanism to guide the generation of high-resolution details. We further introduce SRT-large, a scaled-up version with extensive pre-training, which enables strong zero-shot super-resolution capability. Extensive experiments on nine public datasets demonstrate that SRT and SRT-large consistently outperform existing methods across multiple scale factors, showing both robust performance and the effectiveness of each component in our architecture.

</details>


### [478] [Enhancing AI Interpretability and Safety through Localised Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07998)
*Ian Seet,Jonas Bozenhard,Simon Ostermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出局部化硬件机器学习架构（如更低带宽但更高每节点表达力的架构）相比运行在GPU集群上的深度神经网络，在小型数据集上更具可解释性和计算效率，并评估了多种硬件ML范式在该方向上的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型生成式AI模型（LLMs、LRMs）在可解释性、安全性和可持续性方面存在严重问题，其不透明性源于深度神经网络的弥散性本质和对GPU集群的依赖。作者希望通过类比局部化ML模型在小数据集上的优势，探索局部化硬件架构能否带来类似的可解释性和效率提升。

Method: 采用类比推理方法：从局部化机器学习模型（更可解释、计算高效）类比到局部化硬件ML架构。然后对多种硬件ML范式（如物理神经网络、存算一体架构等）进行系统性评估，比较其每节点表达力、能效和技术成熟度。

Result: 局部化硬件架构有潜力在小型数据集上比GPU集群上的深度神经网络更具可解释性，同时保持竞争力。不同硬件ML范式在每节点表达力、能效和技术成熟度上存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 局部化硬件ML架构是值得探索的方向，有望平衡可解释性、计算效率与模型性能，尤其适合数据受限场景。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative AI, especially powerful Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), raise concerns over the interpretability, safety and sustainability of these large and opaque AI models. The power of such architectures is derived not only from the scalability of deep neural networks, but also massively parallel hardware such as GPU clusters. The diffuse nature of deep neural networks gives them great function-approximation capability when provided with sufficient training data but imposes a cost in interpretability and computational efficiency. Observing that localised machine learning (ML) models tend to be more interpretable and computationally efficient than deep neural networks on small datasets, we reason by analogy that similar advantages may apply to specific localised hardware ML architectures. We argue that localised architectures with lower bandwidth but higher expressivity per node have the potential to be fundamentally more interpretable than deep neural networks running on GPU clusters while remaining competitive for smaller datasets. We then evaluate the suitability of various hardware ML paradigms for implementing such localised architectures and evaluate their per-node expressivity, energy efficiency and practical maturity of the technology required.

</details>


### [479] [Reformulate LLM Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Training under Black-box Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08779)
*Jiashun Liu,Runze Liu,Xu Wan,Jing Liang,Hongyao Tang,Ling Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（DCMDP）的强化学习框架，通过动态调整训练-推理行为一致性约束，解决了强化学习后训练阶段因训练与推理引擎架构差异导致的隐式不匹配问题，在保持策略探索效率的同时防止性能崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习作为重要的后训练范式，常出现次优性能甚至训练崩溃。最新研究发现这源于训练和推理引擎与架构差异导致的隐式训练-推理不匹配（discrepancy）。

Method: 1) 发现训练策略可在适当学习信号下自我修正不匹配；2) 实证识别出"不匹配容忍区域"——区域内过度缩小不匹配会抑制探索，区域外减少不匹配可提升优化一致性；3) 据此提出Discrepancy-Constrained MDP (DCMDP)，将奖励最大化与训练-推理行为对齐约束耦合；4) 引入拉格朗日松弛机制动态调整两目标相对权重，实现自适应平衡。

Result: 在Qwen-3-8B（8B稠密模型）和Qwen-3-30B-A3B（30B混合专家模型）上显著提升性能；支持异构训练范式，可在高保真训练环境下优化LLM，同时显式适配低成本、资源受限的推理部署。

Conclusion: DCMDP通过约束训练-推理行为一致性，在容忍区域内允许自由探索、超出边界时引导回归，实现了稳定的双目标优化，有效解决了强化学习后训练中的不匹配问题。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a pivotal post-training paradigm, yet it frequently suffers from unpredictable sub-optimum performance or even training collapses. Recent findings attribute these failures to a hidden train-inference discrepancy (or mismatch), stemming from the disparate underlying engines and architecture. We find that the training policy can actively self-correct such a discrepancy when provided with an appropriate learning signal. Then, we further empirically identify a discrepancy tolerance region: within this region, aggressively narrowing the discrepancy can suppress policy exploration and reduce learning efficiency, whereas outside this region, reducing excessive discrepancy improves optimization consistency and raises the achievable local performance ceiling. According to such findings, we formulate this problem as a Discrepancy-Constrained Markov Decision Process (DCMDP), where reward maximization is coupled with a constraint that aligns training-Inference behavior, achieving stable dual-objective optimization. To adaptively balance performance improvement and discrepancy control, we introduce a Lagrangian relaxation mechanism that dynamically adjusts the relative weight of the two objectives according to the current degree of discrepancy violation. This enables stable dual-objective optimization: the policy is allowed to explore freely within the tolerance region, while being guided back when the discrepancy exceeds the safe boundary. Empirically, DCMDP significantly improves the performance of 8B dense model (Qwen-3-8b) and 30B Mixture-of-Expert model (Qwen-3-30bA3b), and enables a heterogeneous training paradigm, where LLMs can be optimized in high-fidelity training setup while being explicitly aligned for low-cost, resource-constrained inference deployment.

</details>


### [480] [Structural Grid Descriptors Predict Within-Task Solver Success on ARC-AGI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09026)
*Ayan Pendharkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过对两个架构不同的符号ARC-AGI求解器（beam search和Stochastic DFS）的44,800次运行分析，发现中间网格状态的50%轨迹完成度处的结构特征（尤其是网格复杂度相关特征）能预测求解成败，特征迁移性良好，并可用于早期停止以节省计算资源。同时发现DSL原语库在57.25%的评估任务上存在覆盖不足问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验中间网格状态的结构属性是否能预测符号ARC-AGI求解器的成败，即条件互信息 I(X;Y|task) &gt; 0 是否成立，从而理解求解过程中的关键因素。

Method: 在44,800次运行中（2种求解器架构×400个ARC任务×28种配置×训练/评估划分），提取50%轨迹完成度处的手工网格描述子，计算同一任务内成功/失败运行的区分能力（AUC），并通过特征迁移、配置残差化、任务聚类bootstrap等方法进行验证。

Result: 同一任务内最佳特征AUC=0.885；特征跨求解器迁移AUC在0.747-0.762之间；预注册保留集上n_components_final特征AUC=0.765；配置残差化后AUC达0.927和0.896；评分轨迹R²≈0。早期停止减少beam search 33.6%计算量（保留98.9%求解），退化轨迹检测减少SDFS 65.3%计算量（无求解损失）。400个评估任务中有229个DSL原语库无法从输入网格产生有效转换。

Conclusion: 中间网格结构的复杂度特征能预测符号ARC求解成败，具有架构通用性，可用于早期停止优化。同时揭示了DSL原语库的覆盖率瓶颈：大量任务的0步崩溃是语言能力不足而非搜索预算问题。

Abstract: We ask whether structural properties of intermediate grid states predict whether a symbolic ARC-AGI solver will succeed, framed as a test of conditional mutual information I(X;Y|task) > 0. Across 44,800 runs spanning two architecturally distinct solvers (beam search and Stochastic DFS), 400 ARC tasks, 28 configurations per solver, and both training and evaluation splits, hand-crafted grid descriptors measured at 50% trajectory completion discriminate successful from failed runs within the same task (mean within-task best-feature AUC = 0.885, p < 0.001 under within-task label permutation). Most predictive content lies along a single grid-complexity axis. The result generalizes across solver architectures: a feature selected on one solver predicts success on the other with AUC 0.747-0.762 in all four transfer directions (p < 0.001, leakage controlled). On a pre-registered held-out set of 41 reliable tasks, the frozen feature n_components_final achieves AUC = 0.765 (95% CI [0.717, 0.810], p < 0.001), robust under task-clustered bootstrap resampling and cross-solver task collapsing. The signal is not explained by solver capacity (configuration-residualized AUC = 0.927 and 0.896 for beam search and SDFS, p < 0.001) and is only weakly coupled to score trajectories (R^2 approximately 0). Early stopping at 50% completion reduces beam-search compute by 33.6% while retaining 98.9% of solves; degenerate-trajectory detection reduces SDFS compute by 65.3% with no solve loss. Finally, on 229 of 400 evaluation tasks the DSL primitive library produces no valid transition from the input grid. This 0-step collapse is invariant to search budget and universally failed by beam search, indicating a DSL coverage limitation rather than a search-budget effect.

</details>


### [481] [FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09079)
*Yan Wang,Qifan Zhang,Jiachen Yu,Tian Liang,Dongyang Ma,Xiang Hu,Zibo Lin,Chunyang Li,Zhichao Wang,Miao Peng,Nuo Chen,Jia Li,Yujiu Yang,Haitao Mi,Dong Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA)范式，通过神经内存索引器（基于DeepSeek-V4架构）预测未来上下文需求，仅保留关键KV块在GPU内存中，将物理KV缓存压缩至全上下文的13.5%，同时保持或略升下游精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LLM在解码时需加载完整KV缓存，导致超长上下文场景下GPU内存严重瓶颈。

Method: 提出LSA推理范式，构建基于DeepSeek-V4架构的神经内存索引器，采用无骨干解耦训练策略，将索引器视为标准双编码器架构，独立训练，无需加载骨干模型到GPU内存。

Result: 在LongBench-v2、LongMemEval、RULER等评测中，平均KV缓存压缩至全上下文的13.5%，下游精度平均提升0.6%；在500K极端规模下，KV缓存开销降低超90%。

Conclusion: "少即是多"的范式显著提升了服务效率，同时作为长期全局记忆任务中的有效注意力去噪器，不破坏骨干模型的核心推理能力。

Abstract: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing a severe GPU memory bottleneck for ultra-long context serving. In this report, we propose Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA), a novel inference paradigm powered by a Neural Memory Indexer built upon the DeepSeek-V4 architecture. Rather than passively attending to all historical tokens, LSA proactively predicts future context demands and preserves only the query-critical KV chunks in the GPU memory. Crucially, we instantiate this architecture via a backbone-free decoupled training strategy. By formulating the indexer as a standard dual-encoder architecture, we train it independently using standard retrieval training frameworks without ever loading the massive backbone model into GPU memory.
  We demonstrate that this "less is more" paradigm significantly maximizes serving efficiency while acting as an effective attention denoiser in tasks that rely on long-term global memory. Across primary long-context evaluation suites (e.g., LongBench-v2, LongMemEval, and RULER), FM-DS-V4 compresses the average physical KV cache footprint down to merely 13.5% of the full-context baseline, while consistently preserving or slightly elevating downstream accuracy (+0.6% absolute margin on average). Crucially, at extreme 500K scales, FlashMemory suppresses the physical KV cache overhead by over 90% without destabilizing the backbone's core reasoning capacities.

</details>


### [482] [Scaling Neural Network Verification with Tensor Parallelism and Fully Sharded Data Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09377)
*Sergei Vorobyov,Eugene Ilyushin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对形式化神经网络验证中GPU内存瓶颈问题，将张量并行（TP）和全分片数据并行（FSDP）两种大规模训练并行技术适配到auto_LiRPA / α,β-CROWN验证框架中。TP以降低边界紧密度为代价实现约2倍峰值内存缩减；FSDP则产生与单GPU基线比特一致的边界，使基线内存降低80-90%，峰值内存降低34-39%，并支持完整验证和卷积层。实验表明，α-CROWN+BaB模式下的内存瓶颈是逐神经元alpha张量而非权重矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化神经网络验证在实践中受限于GPU内存——标准边界传播算法（IBP、CROWN、α-CROWN）要求权重矩阵和松弛系数矩阵完全驻留在单个加速器上，限制了可验证网络的规模。

Method: 将两种大规模训练并行技术适配到auto_LiRPA / α,β-CROWN验证框架：1）张量并行（TP）跨GPU分片权重和A矩阵；2）全分片数据并行（FSDP）仅分片权重矩阵并逐层执行AllGather操作。

Result: TP在P=2时实现约2倍峰值内存缩减，但边界紧密度因分片区内强制使用IBP替代中间边界而下降。FSDP产生与单GPU比特一致的边界，基线内存降低80-90%，峰值内存降低34-39%，并通过VNN-COMP 2024的CIFAR-100 ResNet-large完整不可满足结果验证。α-CROWN+BaB模式下的内存瓶颈为逐神经元alpha张量。

Conclusion: FSDP可无缝集成到完整验证（β-CROWN + 分支定界）和卷积层中，是缓解验证内存瓶颈的有效方案；未来工作的关键方向是解决逐神经元alpha张量的内存开销问题。

Abstract: Formal neural network verification -- proving that a network satisfies safety properties for *all* inputs in a specified domain -- is bounded in practice by GPU memory: standard implementations of bound-propagation algorithms (IBP, CROWN, $α$-CROWN) require weight and relaxation-coefficient matrices to reside entirely on one accelerator. We adapt two parallelism techniques originally developed for large-scale model training to the auto_LiRPA / $α,β$-CROWN verification framework. Tensor Parallelism (TP) shards both weight and $A$-matrices across GPUs, achieving ${\approx}2\times$ peak-memory reduction at $P{=}2$; soundness is confirmed on VNN-COMP 2022 MNIST-FC benchmarks, though bound tightness degrades with the number of sharded zones due to forced IBP substitution for intermediate bounds inside sharded zones. Fully Sharded Data Parallelism (FSDP) shards only weight matrices with a per-layer AllGather, producing bounds that are bitwise identical to the single-GPU baseline: baseline memory drops by 80--90%, peak memory by 34--39% on wide MLPs. FSDP integrates cleanly with complete verification ($β$-CROWN + Branch-and-Bound) and with convolutional layers (BoundConv); a complete unsat result is obtained for CIFAR-100 ResNet-large (VNN-COMP 2024) under FSDP. Across all experiments the memory bottleneck in $α$-CROWN+BaB mode proves to be per-neuron alpha tensors, not weight matrices, pointing to the key direction for future work.

</details>


### [483] [Assessing Sample Quality in Conditional Generation under Compositional Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09601)
*Berker Demirel,Valentino Maiorca,Marco Fumero,Theofanis Karaletsos,Francesco Locatello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种后验、逐样本的信任分数，用于评估条件生成模型在 extrapolative（外推）场景下生成样本的质量。该分数结合全局真实性和属性忠实度两个可估计量，无需参考目标分布，即可实现对生成样本的过滤、排序和弃权，在生物成像和视觉基准任务上均取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件生成模型在科学领域中常被用于探索稀有、昂贵或尚未观测到的条件组合，但标准评估指标依赖参考目标分布，而外推场景下该分布天然不可得，存在评估的循环困境。

Method: 提出一种后验、逐样本的信任分数，由两个可估计量组成：(1) 全局真实性，衡量样本与真实数据流形的兼容性；(2) 属性忠实度，衡量样本是否更接近请求属性而非其他可行属性。在观测属性满足轻度覆盖条件时，该分数可恢复跨外推生成的比较。

Result: 在生物成像任务中，筛选出的样本保留了更真实的形态结构并提升了下游预测性能；在受控视觉基准上也观察到类似增益。分数还可用于生成过程中的弃权决策。

Conclusion: 所提信任分数有效解决了外推场景下条件生成模型的评估问题，无需参考分布即可实现有效筛选、排序和弃权，且可直接用于现成预训练模型，具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Conditional generators provide a natural tool for controllable generation, including settings where the desired condition is a new composition of observed attributes or experimental factors. In many applications, especially in scientific domains, such models are attractive to explore conditions for which real samples are rare, expensive, or not yet observed. However, this creates a circularity for evaluation: standard conditional quality metrics require a reference target distribution, but in the extrapolative regime that distribution is unavailable by definition. We address this problem with a post-hoc, per-sample trust score for assessing conditional samples using only the training distribution. The score combines two estimable quantities: global realism, measuring compatibility with the real data manifold, and attribute-wise faithfulness, measuring whether a sample is closer to the requested attributes than to plausible alternatives. We show that the score can recover meaningful comparisons across extrapolated generations, under a mild coverage condition on the observed attributes. These comparisons enable effective filtering, ranking, and abstention of generations and can be used directly on off-the-shelf pretrained models. In biological imaging, selected samples preserve real morphological structure better and improve downstream predictive performance, while similar gains are observed on controlled vision benchmarks. Finally, we show how the score can be applied during generation, enabling abstention before full decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/berkerdemirel/faithful-cond-gen.

</details>


### [484] [Learning Dynamics Reveal a Hierarchy of Weight-Induced Layerwise Gram Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09744)
*Claudio Nordio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了具有固定读出和二次损失的ReLU前馈网络，将梯度下降重写为训练集空间上的集体动力学，揭示了残差动力学中的核结构，并展示了从三层网络开始需要权重诱导的Gram算子层次结构来实现闭包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将梯度下降从权重空间的动力学重新表述为训练集空间上的集体动力学，以更清晰地理解深层网络的学习过程。

Method: 通过消除单隐层网络的权重变量，得到残差的封闭方程；对于更深网络，引入权重诱导的Gram算子层次结构，并利用向后拉回递归描述共轭场动力学。

Result: 单隐层残差动力学由输入几何矩阵和动态共激活矩阵因式分解的集体核主导；深度网络中残差动力学保持清晰的逐层核结构，但从三层起需要Gram算子层次实现闭包。

Conclusion: ReLU网络的梯度下降可被理解为训练集空间上的集体动力学，且深层网络的共轭场满足向后拉回递归，其中权重诱导的Gram算子是首个非平凡实例。

Abstract: We study feed-forward ReLU networks with fixed readout and quadratic loss. The aim is to rewrite gradient descent not primarily as a dynamics in weight space, but as a collective dynamics closed in terms of fields defined on the training-set space. For a single hidden layer, the weight variables can be eliminated from the activation dynamics, yielding a closed equation for the residuals governed by a collective kernel that factorizes into an input-geometric matrix and a dynamical co-activation matrix. For deeper networks, the residual dynamics retains a clean layer-wise kernel structure. However, from depth three onward, closure requires a hierarchy of weight-induced Gram operators that mediate information transport across layers. Moreover, the conjugate-field dynamics is governed by operators satisfying a backward pullback recursion, of which the weight-induced Gram operators are the first nontrivial instances.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [485] [Multifractal Signatures of Ageing and Dementia Development: A Multifractal Space-Filling Curve Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10222)
*Marta Lotka,Jacek Grela,Zbigniew Drogosz,Jeremi K. Ochab,Paweł Oświęcimka*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为多重分形空间填充曲线分析（MFSCA）的方法，用于量化多维数据的相关结构。该方法通过分形空间填充曲线将多维数据投影到一维信号，再使用多重分形算法进行分析。通过对人工生成数据和真实MRI数据的验证，发现大脑空间组织的多重分形程度随年龄增长和痴呆症发展而逐渐减弱，出现从多重分形向单分形的转变，表明MRI数据的多重分形性可作为大脑结构变化的标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在量化多维复杂数据的非线性、无标度特性方面存在局限，需要一种高效且能保留局部和长程组织特性的框架来刻画多维数据的相关结构，并探索其在神经退行性疾病标志物发现中的应用潜力。

Method: 提出MFSCA框架：首先利用分形空间填充曲线（如Hilbert曲线）将多维数据投影到一维表示，保留数据的局部和长程组织特性；随后对得到的一维信号应用多重分形算法（如多重分形去趋势波动分析），量化其多重分形谱特征。

Result: 人工生成的多重分形结构和真实MRI数据验证了方法的有效性。对阿尔茨海默病各阶段患者及不同年龄健康对照组的MRI分析显示：随着年龄增长和痴呆症发展，大脑空间组织的多重分形程度逐渐减弱，健康对照组和痴呆症患者组均观察到从多重分形向单分形的转变。

Conclusion: 大脑组织的异质性特征在病况恶化时退化，导致同质且弱相关的结构。MRI数据的多重分形性可作为大脑结构变化的有效标志物，能够捕捉大脑组织的关键方面。

Abstract: Multifractality is an effective formalism for quantifying the nonlinear, scale-free properties of complex data. In this study, we propose a novel and efficient methodology, termed Multifractal Space-filling Curve Analysis (MFSCA), for quantifying the correlation structure of multidimensional data. Within this framework, the original multidimensional data - while preserving both local and long-range organisational properties - are projected onto a one-dimensional representation using a fractal space-filling curve. The resulting one-dimensional signal is then analysed using multifractal algorithms. We demonstrate the utility of the method using both artificially generated multifractal structures and real data. In particular, we apply MFSCA to analyse magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data from Alzheimer patients at different stages of dementia. Based on the results, we estimate the multifractal profiles of the brain for healthy subjects of different ages as well as for dementia patients. The analysis reveals that the spatial organization of brain structures, as measured by the degree of multifractality, progressively weakens with age and the development of dementia. A transition from multifractality to monofractality is observed both in control groups, when comparing the Young Control and Elderly Control groups, and among dementia subjects of similar age but at different stages of the disease, namely early dementia and mild cognitive impairment. Thus, from the perspective of multiscaling properties, the heterogeneous characteristics of spatial brain organization deteriorate under worsening conditions, leading to a homogeneous and weakly correlated structure. These findings not only effectively capture key aspects of brain organisation, but also demonstrate that the multifractality of MRI data can serve as a marker of structural brain changes.

</details>


### [486] [Hyperbolic Neural Population Geometry Benefits Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10238)
*Dennis Wu,Yi-Chun Hung,Braden Yuille,James E. Fitzgerald,Han Liu*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出海马体神经活动的双曲几何结构理论框架，建立神经解码与联想记忆的联系，并引入双曲空间中的新型联想记忆模型，证明其容量显著优于现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期神经生物学实验发现海马体群体活动具有双曲结构特征，但缺乏理论解释。本文旨在为这一现象提供理论框架。

Method: 1) 提出海马体调谐曲线的合理构建方式，统计上诱导双曲几何；2) 证明现代Hopfield网络更新规则等效于最小均方误差估计器，建立神经解码与联想记忆的联系；3) 在双曲空间中定义新型联想记忆模型。

Result: 双曲空间中的联想记忆模型容量显著优于当前主流模型。

Conclusion: 动物将空间信息编码为潜在的隐式双曲认知地图，同时提升记忆容量和解码精度。

Abstract: Neural population geometry shapes downstream computation. Recent empirical findings in neurobiology suggest that a hyperbolic structure underlies population activity in the hippocampus. Here we provide a theoretical framework for this phenomenon. First, we propose a plausible construction of hippocampal tuning curves that statistically induces hyperbolic geometry. Next, we establish a connection between neural decoding and associative memory by demonstrating that the Modern Hopfield Network update rule computes the minimum mean-squared-error (MMSE) estimator. Finally, we introduce a novel associative memory model defined in hyperbolic space that yields significantly larger capacity than leading models. Our results suggest that animals encode spatial information as a latent hyperbolic cognitive map, improving both memory capacity and decoding accuracy.

</details>


### [487] [Sleep EEG Signal Criticality as a Non-Invasive Predictor of Cognitive Decline in Dementia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10889)
*Stanisław Narębski,Tomasz Komendziński,Tomasz M. Rutkowski*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究通过对睡眠EEG信号进行多重分形去趋势波动分析（MFDFA），发现未来进展为痴呆的女性在基线期N2和N3非快速眼动睡眠阶段的Hurst指数H(q)分布显著偏离最优临界状态，而认知健康者的神经动力学更接近临界点（p≤0.001），提示睡眠脑电临界性可作为认知衰退的早期无创生物标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经退行性疾病的早期检测仍是临床重大挑战，亟需非侵入性、可大规模筛查的早期生物标志物。

Method: 利用NSRR SOF纵向队列数据，对基线期睡眠EEG进行MFDFA分析，计算Hurst指数H(q)；比较未来认知正常组与进展为痴呆组（3MS<78）之间的临界动力学差异；采用监督式UMAP投影验证组间空间分离。

Result: 认知健康组在所有电极位置上的信号动力学显著更接近最优临界状态（p≤0.001）；痴呆组DFA指数向1.0偏移，表明睡眠期间无标度神经动力学在临床症状出现前已发生重构；监督式UMAP显示整夜睡眠架构中两组存在清晰的空间分离。

Conclusion: MFDFA衍生的脑电临界性指标可作为自动化的睡眠筛查工具，在痴呆前驱期窗口实现更早的预防性干预。

Abstract: Early detection of neurodegeneration remains a critical clinical challenge. This study investigates whether sleep EEG signal criticality, quantified via Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA), serves as a non-invasive biomarker for future cognitive decline. We analyzed longitudinal data from the National Sleep Research Resource (NSRR) Study of Osteoporotic Fractures (SOF) cohort, comparing baseline sleep EEG dynamics between women who remained cognitively normal and those who later progressed to dementia-related impairment ($3MS < 78$).Our results reveal significant group-level differences in Hurst exponent $H(q)$ distributions, particularly during non-REM stages N2 and N3. Cognitively healthy individuals exhibited signal dynamics significantly closer to an optimally critical state across all electrode locations ($p \leqslant 0.001$), supporting the Brain Criticality Hypothesis. Supervised UMAP projections confirmed clear spatial separation between groups throughout the overnight sleep architecture.The dementia group demonstrated a shift in DFA exponents toward $1.0$, suggesting that a reconfiguration of scale-free neural dynamics during sleep precedes clinical symptoms. These findings highlight the potential for MFDFA-derived measures to be integrated into automated, sleep-based screening tools, enabling earlier preventative interventions during the prodromal window of dementia.

</details>


### [488] [Bilinear gating of motor primitives: a principle linking dendritic computation to rapid goal-directed adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10891)
*Cristiano Capone,Luca Falorsi,Andrea Ciardiello,Luca Manneschi*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文发现运动皮层神经元的爆发分数（burst fraction）比总放电率更选择性编码到达方向，这种分离在多个动物和实验室中高度一致。目标是信息集中在爆发中，其机制是第5层锥体神经元树突的 coincidence detection 产生双线性门控 G(g)Y(s)，该机制支持强化学习智能体的零样本泛化和快速在线适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动皮层需要同时编码"产生什么动作"和"服务于哪个目标"，但单个神经元如何分离这两类因素尚不清楚。本文旨在探究神经元是否通过不同放电模式（爆发 vs. 总放电率）来分别编码动作和目标信息。

Method: 1) 在猕猴运动皮层进行神经记录，分析爆发分数与总放电率对到达方向的选择性编码；2) 通过统计检验验证分离的一致性；3) 构建两层室尖峰模型模拟树突 coincidence detection；4) 将双线性门控嵌入强化学习智能体验证计算优势。

Result: 爆发分数比总放电率更选择性编码到达方向，此现象在12个记录会话（3只动物、2个实验室）中均显著成立（p<10^-12），且控制去除放电率贡献后依然存在。爆发概率计算为目标和状态的乘积（双线性门控），该机制在强化学习智能体中支持零样本泛化和快速在线适应。

Conclusion: 爆发分数是运动皮层中目标选择性的编码方式，其机制可追溯到第5层锥体神经元的树突 coincidence detection 产生的双线性门控，这种编码方式具有学习优势。

Abstract: Movement requires the motor cortex to specify both \emph{what} action to produce and \emph{which goal} it serves, yet how individual neurons separate these factors is not understood. Here we show that in macaque motor cortex the \emph{burst fraction} of a neuron, the proportion of its spikes emitted in high-frequency bursts, encodes reach direction far more selectively than its overall firing rate. This dissociation is highly consistent: it holds in every one of 12 recording sessions spanning three animals and two laboratories (all $p<10^{-12}$) and survives controls that remove any contribution of firing rate, showing that goal information is concentrated specifically in bursts. We then show that this coding signature is the predicted consequence of dendritic coincidence detection in layer-5 pyramidal neurons: when a goal-related apical input coincides with a state-related basal drive the neuron bursts, so burst probability computes the product of goal and state, a bilinear gate $G(g)\,Y(s)$. A minimal two-compartment spiking model reproduces the effect, and the same multiplicative gate, embedded in a reinforcement-learning agent, supports zero-shot generalisation to new goals and rapid online adaptation, providing a computational rationale for segregating goal information into bursts. These results identify burst fraction as a goal-selective code in motor cortex, tie it to a concrete cellular mechanism, and show that the mechanism confers a learning advantage.

</details>
