### [489] [Leveraging Social Media Data for COVID-19 Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10459)
*Nur Hafieza Ismail,Nur Shazwani Kamarudin,Nurol Husna Che Rose*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本章综述了COVID-19疫情期间社交媒体平台的使用研究，分析了用户披露中的语言、视觉和情感指标，并对所采用的机器学习、特征工程、自然语言处理和调查方法进行了分类，同时指出了未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体已成为获取COVID-19相关信息的主要来源，其海量用户和自由传播特性对公众认知和应对疫情产生重大影响，因此有必要系统梳理相关研究。

Method: 通过文献综述方式，对社交媒体数据（语言、视觉、情感指标）进行分析，并对机器学习、特征工程、自然语言处理和调查方法进行分类总结。

Result: 该章节系统分类了社交媒体数据类型、所采用的分析方法，并识别了用户披露中表达的语言、视觉和情感特征。

Conclusion: 社交媒体在合理使用下可作为传播可靠信息和提升公众意识的数字工具，未来研究可在此基础上进一步深入。

Abstract: Nowadays, social media networks have become widely preferred sources of information. Especially during the time of the Coronavirus disease 2019 COVID 19 pandemic, social media has been one of the most used platforms to get the latest news and information related to COVID 19. Social media are popular because they offer free access to their registered users and allow them to do posting, disseminate information, and respond to others postings. With almost 4.6 billion social media users worldwide, it is not surprising the significant amount of information shared through these platforms could affect how people perceive and cope with the pandemic that we are facing right now. With decent use, social media can be a beneficial digital tool to spread reliable news and public awareness for patients, clinicians, and society. Specifically, this chapter describes linguistic, visual, and emotional indicators expressed in user disclosures. Thus, in this chapter, the related studies of social media platforms usage during the COVID 19 pandemic are explored and discussed in detail. This chapter also categorizes social media data used, introduces different deployed machine learning, feature engineering, natural language processing, and survey methods, and outlines directions for future research.

</details>


### [490] [From Stacks to Circuits: A Regenerative Socio-Technical Roadmap for AI Infrastructure within Planetary Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10544)
*Han-Teng Liao,Karen Ang*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种再生式社会技术路线图，将AI基础设施重新定义为受行星边界约束的“系统之系统”，通过整合IEEE IRDS可持续性考虑和代谢回路框架，将“价值观与需求”置于生产-消费关系循环中，以解决当前生成式AI扩展中的热力学和材料成本外部化问题，并为数字循环经济提供监管合规和产业韧性的行动路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生成式AI的线性供给侧“堆栈”扩展轨迹追求性能密度，却将显著的热力学和材料成本外部化。随着绿色与数字“双重转型”加速，行业面临包括范围3排放和电子垃圾回收在内的技术缺口，这些阻碍了可持续扩展并导致社会紧张。

Method: 研究将可持续生产与消费系统图重新用于AI基础设施，将其重构为受行星边界约束的“系统之系统”；整合IEEE IRDS半导体设施的可持续性考量；提出以“价值观与需求”为中心的代谢回路框架；识别当前以Nvidia为中心的路线图的关键缺口并提出竞争性参考架构。

Result: 识别了当前以Nvidia为中心的路线图的关键缺口；提出了竞争性参考架构；展示了资源节俭和行星问责的自发秩序如何为数字循环经济中的监管合规和产业韧性提供可行的行动路径。

Conclusion: 通过再生式社会技术路线图和代谢回路框架，可以在数字循环经济中将资源节俭与行星问责的自发秩序转化为监管合规和产业韧性的实际行动路径。

Abstract: Current scaling trajectories for Generative AI, typified by linear supply-side "stacks," prioritize performance density while externalizing significant thermodynamic and material costs. As the "Twin Transition" of green and digital transformation accelerates, the industry faces technology gaps - including Scope 3 emissions and e-waste recycling - that impede sustainable scaling and lead to social tensions. This study proposes a Regenerative Socio-Technical roadmap that repurposes the Sustainable Production and Consumption system map to reframe artificial intelligence infrastructure as a system-of-systems governed ultimately by planetary limits. By integrating the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers International Roadmap for Devices and Systems (IEEE IRDS) sustainability considerations for semiconductor facilities, the study proposes a metabolic circuit framework that centers "Values and Needs" within production and consumption relationship loops. This study identifies critical gaps in current Nvidia-centric roadmaps and proposes a competing reference architecture. It demonstrates how a spontaneous order of resource parsimony and planetary accountability can provide an actionable pathway for regulatory compliance and industrial resilience in the digital circular economy.

</details>


### [491] [Platform Sorting Drives Ideological Fragmentation in the Social Media Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10575)
*Edoardo Di Martino,Alessandro Galeazzi,Matteo Cinelli,Michele Starnini,Walter Quattrociocchi*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究通过对2020和2024年美国大选期间六大社交平台（Bluesky、Facebook、Reddit、Truth Social、Twitter/X、YouTube）的政治信息动态分析，发现意识形态碎片化不仅存在于平台内部社区，更表现为跨平台的"平台排序"现象——用户倾向于聚集在意识形态一致的平台上。各平台呈现出从极左到极右的稳定意识形态轮廓，且在两次选举周期中保持稳定。长期追踪显示，持续活跃用户群体的意识形态变异性有限，说明单平台内的表观变化反映了整个生态系统层面的排序，而非向中立的趋同。这种平台排序是社交媒体生态系统的持久结构性特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究多将网络政治传播中的意识形态不对称视为平台内部社区层面的局部现象，但忽略了用户可能在平台层面进行意识形态筛选和分化的可能性。本研究旨在揭示这种宏观层面的"平台排序"机制及其持久性。

Method: 综合使用内容分享、参与分配和用户层面意识形态定向的测量方法，对2020年和2024年美国总统大选期间Bluesky、Facebook、Reddit、Truth Social、Twitter/X和YouTube六大平台的政治信息动态进行跨平台比较分析，并结合纵向追踪分析持续用户群体的意识形态变化。

Result: 意识形态碎片化在所有平台上一致出现且持久存在；各平台呈现出从极左到极右的稳定意识形态轮廓，且跨选举周期保持稳定；持续用户群体的意识形态变异性有限，说明单平台变化反映的是生态系统层面的排序而非向中立趋同。

Conclusion: 平台排序不是对政治事件或审核干预的短暂反应，而是社交媒体生态系统的持久结构性特征。

Abstract: Ideological asymmetries in online political communication are often studied as localized phenomena emerging within communities. Here, we show that fragmentation instead operates at the level of entire platforms, consistent with a process of platform sorting in which users increasingly align with ideologically congruent environments. We analyze political information dynamics across Bluesky, Facebook, Reddit, Truth Social, Twitter/X, and YouTube during the 2020 and 2024 US presidential elections, combining measures of content sharing, engagement allocation, and user-level ideological orientation. Across platforms, ideological fragmentation emerges consistently and persists over time. Platforms exhibit distinct ideological profiles that persist across the two election cycles, ranging from strongly left-leaning to strongly right-leaning environments. Longitudinal analyses further reveal limited ideological variability among persistent user cohorts, indicating that apparent changes within single platforms reflect ecosystem-level sorting rather than convergence toward neutrality. Taken together, our results show that the dynamics of platform sorting is not a transient reaction to political events or moderation interventions, but a persistent structural feature of the social media ecosystem.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [492] [The Empirically Grounded Adaptive Virtual Patient for Psychotherapy Training: Disclosure That Responds to Therapist Micro-Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10051)
*Angela Chen,Siwei Jin,Catherine Bao,Canwen Wang,Robert E. Kraut,Tongshuang Wu,Haiyi Zhu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应虚拟患者（AVP），利用结构方程模型分析近2000小时心理治疗转录数据，根据治疗师的共情和探索技能动态调整患者的自我披露程度，在80次会话评估中显示出比基线更好的适应性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模拟患者在训练心理治疗微技能时存在局限：要么遵循固定脚本，要么依赖LLM在长时间会话中产生不可预测的漂移，缺乏根据受训者技能水平自适应调整的能力。

Method: 基于近2000小时真实心理治疗转录数据拟合结构方程模型，量化治疗师的共情和探索如何影响患者开放性；LLM在动态模块每轮更新的披露水平条件下生成患者话语。

Result: 在20名临床医生和受训者进行的80次会话（1033轮次）评估中，AVP的披露水平随治疗师共情和探索能力提升而上升，而纯提示基线保持平稳；消融实验证实经验驱动的参数化优于替代方案，其中探索携带了大部分自适应信号。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的自适应虚拟患者能够有效响应治疗师的微技能表现，为心理治疗培训提供更真实、可扩展的模拟训练方式。

Abstract: Simulated patients offer a scalable way to train psychotherapy micro-skills such as empathic responding and exploratory probing, but current systems either follow fixed scripts or rely on LLMs that drift unpredictably over long sessions. We present the Adaptive Virtual Patient (AVP), which adapts its disclosure behavior -- from guarded, through moderate openness, to full disclosure -- in response to trainee skill. The AVP is grounded in a structural equation model fit to nearly 2{,}000 hours of real-world psychotherapy transcripts, which quantifies how therapist empathy and exploration shift a patient's openness over time. An LLM generates the AVP's utterances conditioned on a disclosure level that the dynamics module updates each turn. In an evaluation with 20 clinicians and trainees over 80 sessions (1{,}033 turns), the AVP's disclosure rises in response to therapist empathy and exploration, while a prompt-only baseline stays flat; ablations confirm that the empirically motivated parameterization outperforms alternatives, with exploration carrying most of the adaptive signal.

</details>


### [493] ["Where is this coming from?" Uncovering Trustworthiness Ideals in AI-powered Peripartum Information Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10158)
*Vaibhav Balloli,Julia Erickson,Xinyi Li,Erin MacMurray van Liemt,Alex Peahl,Elizabeth Bondi-Kelly*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过24名围产期利益相关者（分娩者、临床医生、健康工作者）的焦点小组研究，发现高风险健康场景下的AI系统可信度必须可检查而非仅声称。研究提炼出四项治理要求：支持社会与身份驱动的意义建构、多元验证实践、可检查的治理与申诉机制、生态感知整合。最终提出不信任感知的设计框架和透明化治理机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI孕产健康系统仅聚焦于提供事实性回答，忽视了影响信任、使用和实际伤害的社会技术治理结构，且美国在可预防孕产妇死亡方面存在种族差异严重的问题。

Method: 开展4场同步焦点小组（n=24），涵盖分娩者、临床医生及健康工作者（导乐、社工、社区健康工作者）三类核心利益相关群体，围绕信息寻求、临床基础设施体验、 misinformation 及AI事实回答设计探针进行归纳分析。

Result: 发现利益相关者在信息可信度标准上存在分歧，但在透明度、申诉机制和生态系统互补性上达成共识。识别出四项治理主题：社会与身份意义建构、多元验证、可检查治理、生态感知整合。

Conclusion: 提出不信任感知（mistrust-aware）的设计人工制品和原则性治理机制，以构建透明、多元的AI系统，并讨论了对人类-AI评估及部署系统透明度的扩展意义。

Abstract: AI-powered tools increasingly promise to fill information gaps in health, especially in domains like maternal and reproductive health that demand timely, accurate, and actionable information. This is extremely important, as the United States leads peer nations in preventable deaths, with stark racial disparities. However, current AI and NLP-powered systems aim to improve access to vetted maternal health information by routing user queries to a factual response while under-specifying the socio-technical governance structures that shape trust, use, and harm in practice. We report findings from four synchronous focus groups ($n=24$) with three stakeholder groups central to peripartum information support: birthing people, clinicians, and health workers (e.g., doulas, social workers, community health workers) exploring topics around information seeking, experience with current clinical infrastructure, misinformation, and an AI-enabled factual answering tool design probe. Our inductive analysis surfaces a central finding: in high-stakes health contexts shaped by historical inequities, trustworthiness must be inspectable and not asserted. While stakeholders diverge on what makes information credible, they converge on the need for transparency, recourse, and ecosystem complementarity. Based on the discussions, we identify four themes and governance requirements: (1) support for social and identity-based sensemaking, (2) pluralistic verification practices, (3) inspectable governance with recourse mechanisms, and (4) ecosystem-aware integration that avoids shifting burden. Building on these findings, we propose design artifacts that are mistrust-aware and promote principled governance mechanisms for transparent, pluralistic AI systems. Finally, we discuss the implications of our findings for expanding human-AI evaluations and improving the transparency of deployed AI systems.

</details>


### [494] [AnnotateThis: Analyzing a human-LLM system for annotating social media data with the concept of climate change mitigation pessimism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10210)
*Zexuan Li,Derek Van Berkel,Ariel Hasell,Grant Schoenebeck,John Barry Ryan,Sabina Tomkins*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出AnnotateThis，一个以人为中心的系统，用于检查和改进LLM的标注质量（称为LLM接地）。通过两阶段评估，证明该系统能显著提升标注效果，在F-Measure和准确率上分别提升0.15和0.23，超越全自动提示优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在计算社会科学等复杂概念任务中表现不佳，CSS社区呼吁开发以人为中心的LLM辅助科研系统。现有方法缺乏人类介入机制，无法有效提升LLM在复杂概念标注上的质量。

Method: 开发AnnotateThis系统，提供多种信息特征供用户检查LLM标注质量。在两种设置下评估：(1) 无真实标签且用户概念知识有限；(2) 有真实标签且概念已明确。比较人类介入与全自动提示优化方法的性能。

Result: 两种设置下用户均能提升LLM标注质量。在有真实标签的评估中，AnnotateThis在F-Measure上绝对提升0.15，准确率提升0.23，超越最先进的全自动提示优化方法。

Conclusion: 以人为中心的LLM标注改进系统（LLM接地）能有效提升复杂概念标注质量，且在有/无真实标签的场景下均有效，远超无人类干预的自动化方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into research workflows. However, LLMs have been shown to struggle with difficult and nuanced concepts such as those found in computational social science (CSS) research. Within the CSS community, there has been a call for new systems to be developed which center humans in LLM-supported scientific workflows. We develop AnnotateThis, a human-centered system for inspecting and improving LLM annotations, a process we refer to as LLM grounding for a target concept. AnnotateThis is developed with both computational and social scientists to reflect existing workflows for data annotation. It includes a range of information features for users to interrogate the quality and reliability of LLM annotations. We evaluate our system in two settings. In the first, we assume a researcher may not have access to ground truth data and that users of AnnotateThis have limited prior knowledge of the concept they would like an LLM to annotate. That is, they may be conducting concept specification and LLM grounding simultaneously. In the second setting, we assume access to ground truth labels and that the concept is specified for a given annotation task; here, the task of LLM grounding is more straightforward. We find that in both settings users can improve the quality of LLM annotations with AnnotateThis and that their final annotations far surpass those created without human intervention. For example, when we evaluate with ground truth labels, we see an absolute improvement of 0.15 in F-Measure and 0.23 in accuracy over a fully automated state-of-the-art method for prompt refinement.

</details>


### [495] [Accounting for AI Inference in Corporate GHG Inventories: A Four-Tier Methodology for Scope 3 Category 1 Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10660)
*Guillermo Llopis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 针对CSRD Scope 3 Category 1中AI推理服务排放核算缺乏标准化方法的问题，提出四层框架（从基于token的物理估算到支出法EEIO兜底），相比现有EEIO方法可将误差从10-40倍降至合理范围。应用于200人欧洲企业案例，总排放低于1 tCO2e，并揭示了水电碳权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI推理服务明确属于CSRD范围三类别1，但尚无标准化的温室气体核算方法。现有实践要么忽略此类别，要么使用ICT行业整体EEIO因子，导致高估排放10-40倍，亟需精确且可行的核算框架。

Method: 提出四层框架：(1) 基于token的物理估算（GPU能耗基准×区域电网碳强度）；(2) 基于能耗的估算；(3) 基于支出的估算；(4) EEIO兜底法。排放因子来自ML.ENERGY Leaderboard v3、EPA eGRID 2023、Ember 2023及Li et al. 2025的水效数据。

Result: 应用于200人欧洲企业，总排放低于1 tCO2e。揭示瑞典水电主导电网碳强度最低但水足迹最高，现有ESG工具未反映这一水碳权衡。

Conclusion: AI推理排放核算的合规挑战本质是方法论问题而非排放量级问题；需关注数据中心选址中水碳权衡；为CSRD合规提供了可操作的标准化方法。

Abstract: AI inference services -- API subscriptions, enterprise chat tools, and SaaS products with embedded AI features -- fall unambiguously within Scope 3 Category 1 under the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), which requires disclosure for fiscal years starting January 2024. Yet no standardised methodology exists for including them in corporate GHG inventories. Current practice either omits the category entirely or applies a generic economic input-output (EEIO) factor calibrated to the ICT sector as a whole, overestimating AI inference emissions by 10-40x relative to physically derived alternatives.
  We propose a four-tier framework that matches estimation precision to the data organisations can realistically obtain, progressing from direct token-based physical estimation -- using GPU energy benchmarks and regional grid carbon intensities -- down to a spend-based EEIO fallback for services where no usage data exists. Emission factors are derived from peer-reviewed GPU energy benchmarks (ML.ENERGY Leaderboard v3), confirmed grid carbon intensities (EPA eGRID 2023; Ember 2023), and published water use effectiveness data (Li et al., 2025). Applied to a 200-person European firm, the framework yields a total below 1 tCO2e, illustrating that the compliance challenge is methodological rather than magnitude-driven. We further document a water-carbon trade-off that current ESG tools do not surface: Sweden's hydro-dominated grid delivers the lowest carbon intensity in our dataset but the highest water footprint, with direct implications for data centre location strategy.

</details>


### [496] [The Agentic Web Requires New Normative Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10711)
*Cameron Pattison,Matthew Boulos,Noam Kolt,Changbai Li,Tiziano Piccardi,Seth Lazar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了代理网络（Agentic Web）时代所需的法律、规范和实践基础设施，指出当前法律和服务条款阻碍了AI代理代表用户在线行动，呼吁社会对话以建立广泛接受的规范体系，从而在保护各方合法利益的前提下，赋予用户委托的代理以合理的在线行动自由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理网络在技术上已可行，但过时的法律、服务条款和非正式实践阻碍了AI代理代表用户诚信行事所带来的消费者和社会效益；当前系统未区分"恶意机器人"和经用户明确授权的AI代理，亟需建立规范基础设施。

Method: 本文通过识别阻碍代理访问的法律和规范障碍，提出指导性原则，并倡导有利于用户委托代理在线行动的政策，旨在引发全社会范围的讨论。

Result: 指出当前缺乏对恶意机器人与经用户授权AI代理的区分，现有法律和服务条款允许平台秘密封锁或降级代理访问；提出需要建立广泛接受的规范体系。

Conclusion: 代理网络的发展不仅需要技术协议和接口基础设施，更需要一套法律、规范和实践构成的规范性基础设施；需要通过全社会对话来建立这些规范，在保障各方合法利益的前提下，尽可能减少对用户授权代理在线行动的限制。

Abstract: The agentic web, in which users interact with the internet largely through agents acting on their behalf, is now technically feasible. However, many of the consumer and social benefits that could be realized by online AI agents acting scrupulously in their principals' interest are currently obstructed by outdated laws, terms of service, and other less formal practices which allow online platforms to block and degrade agent access, often in secret. No distinction is currently drawn between "malicious bots" and AI agents acting with the express delegated authority of a user. For the agentic web to realize its promise, it needs not only the technical infrastructure of protocols and interfaces, but the normative infrastructure of a broadly-accepted and socially-beneficial set of laws, norms and practices governing agentic access to online properties. Building that normative infrastructure requires a society-wide conversation. This paper aims to help precipitate that conversation, to identify normative principles that can guide it, and to advocate for policies that enable users' appropriately delegated agents to act online on their behalf, with as few curbs on their doing so as is reasonable given the other legitimate interests at stake.

</details>


### [497] [Gender-based discrepancies in the algorithmic delivery of political ads on social media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10834)
*Dominik Bär,Francesco Corso,Gianmarco De Francisci Morales,Stefan Feuerriegel,Francesco Pierri*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究利用2024年欧洲议会选举中超过11万条政治广告（覆盖25个欧盟国家）的数据，发现社交媒体算法在投放政治广告时存在显著的性别偏见：民粹和极右翼政党的广告更倾向于触达男性受众（平均男性比例高出6个百分点），即使控制了广告内容、平台竞争和定向策略等因素。这种偏见限制了政党触达多元受众的能力，阻碍选民平等接触不同政治观点，可能加剧政治极化和性别参与差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体已成为选举期间政治广告的关键渠道，但算法偏见可能扭曲公众对政治信息的接触，损害公民做出知情选择的能力，破坏政治话语的平等获取，进而威胁选举过程的完整性。本研究旨在量化这种偏见在性别维度上的具体表现。

Method: 使用2024年欧洲议会选举期间大规模数据集，包含来自453个政党和968名候选人的超过11万条广告，累计产生超过70亿次展示，覆盖25个欧盟国家。通过统计分析，在控制广告内容、平台级竞争和定向策略后，比较男性和女性受众接触不同政治倾向广告的差异。

Result: 男性显著更有可能看到民粹和极右翼政党的广告。在其他条件相同的情况下，民粹主义政党的广告平均触达的男性比例高出6个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究结果强调平台和政策制定者需要审计社交媒体上政治广告的算法投放，并实施保障措施以确保公平性、保护民主进程。

Abstract: Social media has become a key channel for political advertising during election campaigns. However, algorithmic biases in the delivery of these ads may distort the public's exposure to political messaging. This can hinder citizens' ability to make informed choices and undermine equal access to political discourse, raising concerns about the integrity of electoral processes. In this study, we examine gender-based discrimination in the delivery of political ads during the 2024 European Parliament elections. Using a large-scale dataset of over 110000 ads from 453 political parties and 968 candidates that generated over 7 billion impressions across 25 EU countries, we find that men were significantly more likely to be shown ads from populist and far-right parties than women -- even after accounting for ad content, platform-level competition, and targeting strategies. All else equal, ads by populist parties reach, on average, a 6 percentage point higher male share. Such imbalances restrict the ability of parties to reach diverse audiences and prevent voters from engaging equally with the full range of political viewpoints. This pattern is particularly concerning given that far-right and populist ads may reinforce political polarization and widen existing gender gaps in political engagement. Our findings underscore the need for platforms and policymakers to audit algorithmic ad delivery in political campaigns on social media and to implement safeguards that ensure fairness and protect democratic processes.

</details>


### [498] [From Prompt to Purchase: How AI Brand Recommendations Move Consumers on the Open Web](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10907)
*Michael Iannelli,Alan Ai*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过将用户对话数据（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini）与点击流面板匹配，采用事件研究、立场分类、非客户条件限制和同类控制等方法，发现对话助手的品牌提及能使未近期参与的用户在谷歌搜索（+4.3pp）、品牌官网访问（+2.4pp）和零售商页面访问（+1.0pp）上显著提升，而偶然提及效果较弱，且该曝光无法被传统归因方法（如引荐来源、最后一次点击）捕捉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话助手推荐品牌时，用户的线上行为会发生何种变化？传统Web日志无法归因于助手，且朴素漏斗分析因混杂了用户已使用品牌的偶然提及而存在偏差。

Method: 基于用户许可的面板数据，将用户的ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini对话记录与其点击流行为关联；采用前趋势事件研究、立场分类器（区分推荐性提及与偶然提及）、非客户条件限制（排除已有客户），以及同一回复内同类品牌控制（比较被提及品牌与同类别未提及品牌的行为差异）。

Result: 品牌提及使未近期参与用户的谷歌搜索+4.3pp、官网访问+2.4pp、零售商页面访问+1.0pp；偶然提及的效果明显更弱（+1.8/+1.1/+0.3）；被提及品牌的行为提升显著高于同一回复中未提及的其他同类品牌；下游路径以搜索为中介，去向分布与用户基线品牌导向行为一致。

Conclusion: 对话助手的品牌曝光能有效驱动未参与用户的开放网络品牌导航行为，而传统引荐来源和最后一次点击归因无法捕捉这一上游曝光路径。

Abstract: When a conversational assistant recommends a brand to a user with no recent observed engagement, that user's same-name Google search rises +4.3 percentage points (pp) [3.1, 5.5], visits to the brand's own site +2.4 pp [1.4, 3.5], and brand-specific retailer-page visits +1.0 pp [0.3, 1.7] over matched backward placebos. Recovering that estimate is the work. The mention creates a brand exposure no web log attributes to the assistant, and the naive all-mention funnel that seems to measure it is confounded: many mentions are incidental references to brands the user already uses ("your Netflix download"), whose downstream visits are that existing customer's own behavior and surface as a brand-specific pre-trend. We measure off-platform response on a panel that joins opt-in clickstream to the same users' ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini conversations, and isolate the effect with a pre-trend event study, a stance classifier, non-customer conditioning, and a within-response same-category control: incidental name-drops then move behavior far less (+1.8/+1.1/+0.3), and the named brand moves far more than unnamed same-category brands in the same response. The downstream path is mostly search-mediated and reaches both own sites and retailer pages, with a destination mix that tracks baseline brand-directed behavior rather than redirecting toward either. The design is observational and we do not observe transactions, so retail is purchase-adjacent. Standard referrer-based and last-click measurement miss this upstream exposure: assistants move observably-unengaged users into open-web brand navigation along a path attributed elsewhere.

</details>


### [499] [Dismantle and Dissolve, (Re)build, Remix: A Research-creation Inquiry into the Political Economy of Graphics Cards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10958)
*Cyrus Khalatbari*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过四年的调查（2022-2026），运用研究-创作方法（包括在台湾的液氮超频和加纳的城市采矿等实地工作），拆解显卡（GPU）微型化的政治经济学，揭示人工智能的物质性和环境基础设施，为ICT可持续发展领域做出贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重新思考我们与人工智能及其社会技术纠缠的关系，需要揭开显卡这一技术黑箱的神秘面纱，理解其微型化现象背后的政治经济学。

Method: 采用社会科学与研究-创作（research-creation）方法，包括批判性、反思性、推测性和虚构性方法论；在台湾（液氮超频者）和加纳（城市矿工）进行实地调查；对约50块显卡进行情境实验；围绕三个主题展开：拆解与溶解、重建、混音。

Result: 研究-创作方法构成了完整的认识论，能够把握看似外在、不透明或不可及的事物，并将人工智能还原为其有形的物质性。

Conclusion: 研究-创作是严谨的手段，可用于解开计算系统所依赖并掩盖的物质和环境基础设施，从而为ICT可持续发展领域做出贡献。

Abstract: This contribution follows a four-year investigation (2022--2026) into the political economy of graphics card miniaturization. It begins from the premise that rethinking our relationship to artificial intelligence and its sociotechnical entanglements requires demystifying and opening the black box of this technical object. Within our algorithmic culture, the graphics card (GPU) enables the massive, parallel processing of large datasets, making possible the training of the models that underpin our intelligent systems. GPU miniaturization is equally crucial: as a key driver of the Internet of Things, this sociotechnical phenomenon enables the inclusion of these cards in increasingly compact and powerful systems while also enabling better management of energy resources. The development of these everyday objects and technologies nevertheless reinforces several major problems. Drawing on both the social sciences and the critical, reflexive, speculative, and fictional methodologies of research-creation, the author developed several investigative fieldwork sites -- among liquid nitrogen overclockers in Taiwan and urban miners in Ghana -- and conducted situated experimentations on some fifty acquired graphics cards. Structured around three themes (dismantle and dissolve, rebuild, remix), this paper demonstrates how research-creation methods constitute full epistemologies for apprehending what seems a priori external, opaque, or inaccessible, and for restoring artificial intelligence to its tangible materialities. In doing so, it contributes to the field of ICT for sustainability by affirming research-creation as a rigorous means of disentangling the material and environmental infrastructures that computational systems both depend on and obscure.

</details>


### [500] [Designed by Journalists, but Is It for Readers? Rethinking AI Disclosures and Transparency in News](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11116)
*Pooja Prajod*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 新闻编辑室在整合生成式AI时面临披露困境：简短标签无法解释AI参与，详细披露反而降低读者信任。读者真正需要的是以用户自主权为中心的设计（如按需详情、AI比例可视化等），而非传统披露方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决新闻编辑室在整合生成式AI时，如何以维持读者信任的方式沟通AI参与程度这一核心挑战。

Method: 通过一项现有控制实验（34名新闻读者），对比简短一行标签与详细披露（包含人工审核、编辑问责、错误报告机制等）两种当前实践的效果。

Result: 详细披露触发"透明度困境"，降低而非提升信任，并可能引入用户滚动忽略的暗黑模式；简短标签虽避免了该效应，但造成信息鸿沟，读者需花费认知努力搜索AI参与迹象。读者提出了以用户自主权为核心的设计方案：按需详情交互、比例式AI可视化、发布源级别信号、"无AI"明确标签。

Conclusion: 从业人员认为负责任的披露方式与用户实际需求之间存在脱节，这是人机交互社区面临的设计问题。

Abstract: As newsrooms integrate generative AI, journalists face a disclosure challenge: how to communicate AI involvement in ways that maintain reader trust. Current practice offers two approaches: brief one-line labels or detailed disclosures specifying human oversight, editorial accountability, and error reporting mechanisms. Neither achieves journalists' goal of building trust through transparency. An existing controlled experiment with 34 news readers show that detailed disclosures trigger a \textit{transparency dilemma}, reducing trust rather than increasing it, and risk introducing dark patterns that readers scroll past with the illusion of transparency. One-line disclosures avoid this effect but can create an information gap, prompting readers to expend cognitive effort searching for signs of AI involvement that the disclosure indicates but does not explain. Yet readers are not rejecting transparency, they proposed disclosure designs centered on user agency: detail-on-demand interactions, proportional AI-ratio visualizations, outlet-level signals, and explicit "no AI" labels. I argue that this disconnect between what practitioners believe is responsible disclosure and what users actually need is a design problem for the HCI community.

</details>


### [501] [BadRobot: Jailbreaking Embodied LLM Agents in the Physical World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.20242)
*Hangtao Zhang,Chenyu Zhu,Xianlong Wang,Ziqi Zhou,Changgan Yin,Minghui Li,Lulu Xue,Yichen Wang,Shengshan Hu,Aishan Liu,Peijin Guo,Leo Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出BadRobot攻击范式，利用三类漏洞（LLM操控、语言-动作错位、世界知识缺陷）使具身LLM系统执行危险物理行为，通过语音交互突破安全伦理约束，实验证明对Voxposer等主流框架有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身AI研究聚焦于LLM赋能任务规划能力，但忽略了具身LLM系统可能被利用实施有害行为的安全隐患。

Method: 提出BadRobot攻击范式，利用三类漏洞：1) 操控机器人系统中的LLM；2) 语言输出与物理动作之间的错位；3) 世界知识缺陷导致的无意危险行为。构建恶意物理动作查询基准进行评估。

Result: 在Voxposer、Code as Policies、ProgPrompt等主流具身LLM框架上的大量实验验证了BadRobot攻击的有效性。

Conclusion: 具身LLM系统存在严重安全漏洞，可通过语音交互被诱导执行危险行为，亟需加强安全防护。

Abstract: Embodied AI represents systems where AI is integrated into physical entities. Large Language Model (LLM), which exhibits powerful language understanding abilities, has been extensively employed in embodied AI by facilitating sophisticated task planning. However, a critical safety issue remains overlooked: could these embodied LLMs perpetrate harmful behaviors? In response, we introduce BadRobot, a novel attack paradigm aiming to make embodied LLMs violate safety and ethical constraints through typical voice-based user-system interactions. Specifically, three vulnerabilities are exploited to achieve this type of attack: (i) manipulation of LLMs within robotic systems, (ii) misalignment between linguistic outputs and physical actions, and (iii) unintentional hazardous behaviors caused by world knowledge's flaws. Furthermore, we construct a benchmark of various malicious physical action queries to evaluate BadRobot's attack performance. Based on this benchmark, extensive experiments against existing prominent embodied LLM frameworks (e.g., Voxposer, Code as Policies, and ProgPrompt) demonstrate the effectiveness of our BadRobot. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rookie143/BadRobot.

</details>


### [502] [Support for AI Development -- Automated Daily Measurement with Open Data and Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05163)
*Jason Jeffrey Jones*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出并倡导一种新的科学传播形式：通过Web仪表板对公众意见进行自由、开放的即时预测（nowcasting）。作者构建了一个开源自动化系统，每日收集新的调查响应数据，匿名化处理后公开分发微数据，并通过可公开查看的Web仪表板呈现分析结果。演示系统追踪了美国成年人对人工智能发展的支持度，截至2026年5月31日，该系统自主生成了来自8551名受访者的766条每日支持度估计。研究结果强调了持续高频调查对于准确追踪AI等变革性技术公众意见变化的必要性。作者认为更多科学家应采用开放即时预测方法，因其能促进研究设计的透明性并简化复制工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统民意调查频率低、时效性差，难以准确追踪公众对快速变化的技术（如AI）的态度波动。作者希望建立一种透明、高频、开放的民意追踪系统，弥补现有调查方法的不足，同时推动科学传播形式的革新。

Method: 构建开源自动化系统，每日采集新的调查响应数据，对微数据进行匿名化处理并公开分发，通过Web仪表板实时呈现分析结果。演示实现聚焦于美国成年人对AI发展的支持度。

Result: 截至2026年5月31日，系统自主生成了766条每日支持度估计，累计收集8551名受访者数据，实现了高频连续的民意追踪。

Conclusion: 开放即时预测方法能提升研究透明度和可复制性，应被更多科学家采纳，以更准确地追踪公众对变革性技术的态度变化。

Abstract: This manuscript presents and advocates for a new form of scientific communication: free and open nowcasting of public opinion via web dashboard. I present an open-source automated system that gathers new human responses to survey items daily, anonymizes and publicly distributes microdata, and presents analyses through a publicly viewable Web dashboard. A demonstration implementation tracked support for further development of artificial intelligence among American adults. As of 2026-05-31, the system had autonomously produced 766 daily estimates of support from N=8551 respondents. The findings underscore the need for continuous, high-frequency surveys to accurately track shifts in public opinion on transformative technologies like AI. I argue that more scientists should adopt the method of open nowcasting, because it encourages transparency in research design and eases replication.

</details>


### [503] [Large Language Model Chatbot Conversations vs Public Health Materials and Parental HPV Vaccination Intentions: A Randomized Clinical Trial](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.20519)
*Neil K. R. Sehgal,Sunny Rai,Manuel Tonneau,Anish K. Agarwal,Joseph Cappella,Melanie Kornides,Lyle Ungar,Alison Buttenheim,Sharath Chandra Guntuku*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 这项随机临床试验比较了LLM聊天机器人与政府公共卫生材料在提高HPV疫苗接种意愿方面的效果。结果显示，虽然两种方式在短期内都能提升接种意愿，但45天后仅公共卫生材料仍维持一定效果，而聊天机器人的效果消退，且没有任何干预措施能提高实际的疫苗接种率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗系统越来越考虑使用基于LLM的聊天机器人进行疫苗沟通，但缺乏证据表明它们能比现有健康材料产生更持久、与行为相关的效果。

Method: 在美加英三国在线招募1297名家长，随机分为无信息对照组、政府公共卫生材料组（至少3分钟阅读）、默认说服风格GPT-4o聊天机器人组（3分钟交互）、简短对话风格聊天机器人组。主要结局指标为干预后立即测量的12个月内为孩子接种HPV疫苗的可能性（0-100分），并在15天和45天进行随访。

Result: 与对照组相比，公共卫生材料（Cohen d=0.53）、默认聊天机器人（d=0.48）和对话式聊天机器人（d=0.33）均能立即提高接种意愿。但45天时，聊天机器人组效果消退，仅公共卫生材料维持一定效果。所有干预均未提高自我报告的疫苗接种率。

Conclusion: 精心设计的公共卫生材料在HPV疫苗推广方面可能达到甚至超越短时LLM聊天机器人的效果。

Abstract: Health care systems are increasingly considering large language model (LLM)-based chatbots for vaccine communication, but evidence that they improve durable, behaviorally relevant outcomes beyond existing health materials is limited. This randomized clinical trial tested whether brief, multiturn LLM chatbot interactions increased parental intention to vaccinate children against human papillomavirus (HPV) compared with no intervention and government public health materials, and whether effects persisted. Parents in the US, Canada, and UK were recruited online from March 3 to May 25, 2025, with follow-up at 15 and 45 days. Eligible participants were adults with at least one HPV vaccine-eligible child who was unvaccinated or whose vaccination status was unknown. Participants were randomized to no-message control, country-matched government materials with at least 3 minutes of exposure, or a 3-minute GPT-4o chatbot interaction using either a default persuasive style or a shorter conversational style. The primary outcome was self-reported likelihood of vaccinating the child against HPV within 12 months, measured immediately after intervention on a 0-100 scale. Follow-up outcomes included vaccination intent and self-reported vaccination at 15 and 45 days. In total, 1297 participants were randomized (mean age 42.84 years; 72.1% female). Compared with no intervention, public health materials increased immediate vaccination intent (Cohen d = 0.53; 95% CI, 0.36-0.70), as did the default chatbot (d = 0.48; 95% CI, 0.30-0.65) and conversational chatbot (d = 0.33; 95% CI, 0.17-0.49). At 45 days, neither chatbot increased intent relative to controls, whereas public health materials maintained modest effects. No intervention increased self-reported vaccination uptake. Findings suggest well-designed public health materials may match or exceed short LLM chatbot conversations for HPV vaccine promotion.

</details>


### [504] [Quantifying Perception-Based Student Success with Generative AI: An Exploratory Monte Carlo Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01062)
*Seyma Yaman Kayadibi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究基于PRISMA系统文献检索，选取6项实证研究中的1个10题项5点Likert量表，通过逆方差加权蒙特卡洛模拟生成10,000条合成观测数据，构建了一个可量化学生对GenAI工具感知成功度的概率建模框架，发现系统效率和学习负担对复合得分影响最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT）在高等教育中的使用日益广泛，但如何量化学生对其有用性、可用性和教育价值的感知成功度尚缺乏系统的方法论框架。

Method: 采用PRISMA方法在Scopus中进行结构化文献检索，筛选出2023-2025年间19项实证研究，其中6项报告了适合概率建模的题项级均值和标准差；选取1个一致性较高的10题项5点Likert量表作为概念验证数据集，通过逆方差加权蒙特卡洛模拟生成10,000个合成观测值。

Result: 权重结构对模拟结果有显著影响，系统效率和学习负担获得最大的逆方差权重，从而对复合得分产生最强影响。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一个透明、可复现且保护隐私的概念验证框架，将结构化文献检索、题项级汇总统计与概率建模相结合，为未来GenAI感知研究提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools such as ChatGPT have attracted growing attention in higher education, particularly in relation to how students perceive their usefulness, usability, and educational value. This study develops an exploratory Monte Carlo simulation framework for quantifying perception-based student success in the context of GenAI use. A PRISMA-informed structured literature search in Scopus identified nineteen empirical studies published between 2023 and 2025, of which six reported item-level means and standard deviations suitable for probabilistic modelling. One coherent 10-item, 5-point Likert-scale usability-oriented instrument was selected as a canonical proof-of-concept dataset and used to parameterise an inverse-variance-weighted Monte Carlo simulation generating 10,000 synthetic observations. The results show that the weighting structure substantially influences the simulated outcome, with System Efficiency and Learning Burden receiving the largest inverse-variance weight and therefore the strongest influence on the composite score. The study offers a transparent, reproducible, and privacy-preserving proof-of-concept framework linking structured literature search, item-level summary statistics, and probabilistic modelling.

</details>


### [505] [Who Gets Flagged? The Pluralistic Evaluation Gap in AI Content Watermarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13776)
*Alexander Nemecek,Osama Zafar,Yuqiao Xu,Wenbiao Li,Erman Ayday*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 水印技术正成为AI内容认证的默认机制，但其信号强度、可检测性和鲁棒性依赖于内容本身的统计属性，这些属性在不同语言、文化视觉传统和人口群体中存在系统性差异。本文揭示了这种内容依赖性如何创建特定模态的偏差路径，发现除一个基准外，其他水印基准均未跨语言、文化内容类型或人口群体报告性能。为此提出了三个多元化水印基准评估维度：跨语言检测公平性、多元文化内容覆盖和检测指标的群体细分。本文主张水印应作为多元化对齐管线的一部分，并接受相同的评估标准，连接至当前未要求公平性评估便强制部署水印的治理框架，最终立场是评估必须先于部署，AI模型的偏差审计要求应延伸至验证层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水印技术虽被治理框架视为内容溯源的基础设施，但其性能依赖内容的统计属性，而这些属性在不同语言、文化和人口群体中系统性变化，可能导致公平性偏差，但目前水印基准测试普遍缺乏对多元化群体的评估。

Method: 跨文本、图像、音频模态系统审视水印信号的内容依赖性如何产生偏差路径；调研主要水印基准测试的多样性报告情况；提出三个多元化基准评估维度（跨语言检测公平性、多元文化内容覆盖、检测指标的群体细分）。

Result: 除一项基准外，当前主流水印基准均未报告跨语言、跨文化内容类型或不同人口群体下的性能表现。水印技术存在模态特定的偏差路径，但缺乏相应的评估框架。

Conclusion: 水印技术应被视为多元化对齐管线的一部分，需接受与AI模型相同的公平性评估标准；评估必须优先于部署，AI模型的偏差审计要求应延伸至验证层；当前治理框架强制部署水印但未要求公平性评估存在严重不足。

Abstract: Watermarking is becoming the default mechanism for AI content authentication, with governance policies and frameworks referencing it as infrastructure for content provenance. Yet across text, image, and audio modalities, watermark signal strength, detectability, and robustness depend on statistical properties of the content itself, properties that vary systematically across languages, cultural visual traditions, and demographic groups. We examine how this content dependence creates modality-specific pathways to bias. Reviewing the major watermarking benchmarks across modalities, we find that, with one exception, none report performance across languages, cultural content types, or population groups. To address this, we propose three concrete evaluation dimensions for pluralistic watermark benchmarking: cross-lingual detection parity, culturally diverse content coverage, and demographic disaggregation of detection metrics. We argue that watermarking is part of the pluralistic alignment pipeline and should be held to the same evaluation standards. We connect this to governance frameworks currently mandating watermarking deployment without requiring fairness evaluation. Our position is that evaluation must precede deployment, and that the same bias auditing requirements applied to AI models should extend to the verification layer.

</details>


### [506] [Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00038)
*J. Paul Liu,Rachel Levy*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个五阶段AI素养连续体模型（0-未参与、1-非批判使用、2-知情使用、3-批判评估、4-改进），用于描述高等教育中学习者与AI工具互动的认知发展路径，并基于北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者）提供了观察性证据，展示参与者从非参与或非批判使用向知情参与的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架提供了能力定义，但缺乏诊断学习者起点和追踪其进步路径的实用指导，且学生在AI工具使用中常呈现两极分化（因恐惧/伦理担忧而回避，或非批判性依赖），需要更精细的发展性框架来弥合这一鸿沟。

Method: 采用设计型研究方法，提出五阶段AI素养连续体模型，并通过北卡罗来纳州立大学2024年秋季至2026年春季期间学分课程和密集型实践工作坊（330+参与者）进行实施观察，以实践为基础的证据收集方式记录参与者行为变化。

Result: 参与者表现出从非参与或非批判使用向知情参与的行为转变；持续且嵌入学科的体验产生了更强的批判评估和改进导向实践的证据。由于缺乏经过验证的前/后测工具和对照组，研究结果被定性为观察性和基于实践的。

Conclusion: AI素养应被理解为一种发展性能力，而非单纯的工具采纳；该连续体为教育者提供了与UNESCO和OECD等国际框架对齐的实用诊断与教学路径；需要进一步讨论课程路径、机会考量、评估策略等内容。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.

</details>


### [507] [Contemporary AI lacks the imagination to diverge or negate in science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08251)
*Honglin Bao,Siyang Wu,Xiao Liu,Sida Li,Shiyun Cao,James A. Evans*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模科学家参与实验（121,640篇预印本、6,749位科学家、25,139组评分），评估了LLM在科学发现中的能力边界。发现：(1) 非推理LLM易陷入"群体思维"，推理模型能探索更宽假设空间但无法自发提出零假设；(2) 科学家偏爱与自己想法相似且高概率的假设，社会科学家更容忍风险，资深社会科学家批评最严厉；(3) 现有自动评估器（LLM-as-a-judge、人工指标、SOTA模型）与专家判断一致性弱，而基于人类评分微调的Qwen3-14B奖励模型提升了27%的性能，接近独立审稿人间一致性。结论：当前科学AI仍需要人类引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管AI加速科学发现的宣称很多，但缺乏大规模、科学家在环的实证测试。现有研究多依赖自动化评估，未能反映真实科研场景中人类专家的判断。

Method: 邀请121,640篇近期预印本（涵盖生物、医学、化学、社会科学）的作者，让LLM基于论文背景和未解决问题生成想法，由科学家对新颖性、实证可行性、真实性概率和采用偏好进行评分，共收集25,139组评分。

Result: (1) 非推理LLM产生同质化想法，推理模型探索更广但无法提出零假设；(2) 科学家偏好高概率和自己相似的想法，社会科学领域容忍风险更高；(3) 现有自动评估器与专家判断一致性弱，Qwen3-14B奖励模型微调后提升27%，接近评审间一致性。

Conclusion: AI在科学发现中仍有明显局限，尤其在需要语境理解和理论演化的社会科学领域；其想象力、输出和判断仍需人类校准和引导。

Abstract: Bold projections that artificial intelligence will accelerate scientific discovery have raced ahead of evidence from working scientists, and the field still lacks large-scale, scientist-in-the-loop tests of these claims. Here we mount the largest such evaluation to date and map what AI cannot yet do for science. We invited authors of 121,640 recent preprints across biology, medicine, chemistry, and the social sciences to judge ideas that large language models (LLMs) generated from the context and puzzles of their own papers. 6,749 scientists returned 25,139 sets of ratings on novelty, empirical feasibility, probability of being true, and favorability of adoption. Three patterns emerge. First, non-reasoning LLMs collapse into a narrow "hivemind" of similar ideas; reasoning models roam a wider hypothesis space, yet no model class spontaneously proposes null hypotheses -- a move humans make more freely. Second, scientists reward ideas that resemble their own and prize probability over novelty, though social scientists tolerate risk more readily than life scientists. Senior social scientists are the harshest critics, and their skepticism is well-earned: LLMs falter most in pluralistic fields like the social sciences that demand context-aware interpretation and evolving theories. Third, automated evaluators on which the community currently relies -- LLM-as-a-judge, artificial metrics, and even state-of-the-art (SOTA) models -- agree only weakly with expert judgment, and retrieval augmentation and scientist persona prompting yield only marginal gains. A Qwen3-14B reward model we post-trained on human ratings captures field taste nuances, beats SOTA models by up to 27%, and closes the gap to the inter-rater consistency of independent peer reviewers. For all the hype, today's scientific AI still represents a collaborator whose imagination, outputs and judgment benefit from human grounding.

</details>
